title: Virtual Assistant / Appointment Setter (Full-Time)
description:
Remote Position | Full-Time | Starting Pay: $3.00/hour + Bonus Opportunities 



We are seeking a motivated and experienced Virtual Assistant (VA) to join our growing team. This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, highly organized, and experienced in cold calling and appointment setting. Experience working with insurance leads or sales teams is highly preferred.



Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to warm and cold leads daily

* Schedule appointments for agents using company systems

* Follow phone scripts while building rapport with prospects

* Handle basic objections and maintain a professional attitude

* Keep accurate records and notes in CRM systems

* Send appointment confirmations and follow-up messages

* Maintain organized tracking of leads, appointments, and results

* Communicate daily with management regarding performance and goals



Requirements



? Previous experience with cold calling and appointment setting

? Insurance, financial services, or sales experience preferred

? Excellent spoken and written English

? Strong communication and listening skills

? Highly organized with strong attention to detail

? Comfortable working independently and meeting daily goals

? Reliable high-speed internet connection

? Quiet, professional home office/work environment

? Ability to work full-time during U.S. business hours

? Experience using CRMs, dialers, Calendly, or similar scheduling tools is a plus



What We’re Looking For



* Someone who is confident speaking with people over the phone

* A self-starter who can stay productive without constant supervision

* Goal-oriented and motivated by performance

* Positive attitude and willingness to learn



Compensation



* Starting Pay: $3.00 per hour with Bonus Incentives

* Full-time position

* Opportunities for performance-based increases and bonuses based on results



To Apply



Please submit:



1. Your resume

2. A brief summary of your cold-calling and appointment-setting experience

3. MUST submit a voice recording (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and explaining your relevant experience

4. Your internet speed test results



We are looking to hire immediately and are excited to meet candidates who are ready to grow with our team.

title: Administrative & Customer Support Specialist with GoHighLevel Automation Experience...
description:
We are hiring an assistant with proven experience and a strong background in wearing multiple hats. However, please note that this is not your usual VA role.



We need someone who thinks beyond assigned tasks, takes initiative, and actively contributes to solving problems rather than just executing instructions.



This is a full-time, long-term position for someone who is organized, coachable, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift quickly.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You will work directly with our Filipino executive assistant as a dependable partner, supporting the team across various areas of the business and day-to-day operations.



This is best for someone who can show grace under pressure, help keep things organized, communicate clearly, and follow through on tasks.



If you are resourceful, self-motivated, and confident in taking ownership of outcomes without being micromanaged, you may be the right fit for this role.



WORKING HOURS

• Full-time position

• 40 hours per week

• EST/EDT

• Remote setup



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Communicating with clients and teammates through CRM, Slack, and WhatsApp

• Managing schedules, calendars, follow-ups, and day-to-day admin tasks

• Handling ad hoc tasks as needed

• Completing projects that help the business run smoothly and continue growing



QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong written and spoken English communication skills

• Good organization skills and strong attention to detail

• A coachable attitude and willingness to improve

• The ability to think outside the box and complete tasks efficiently

• Initiative to figure things out independently

• A desire for long-term employment, not a part-time or temporary role

• Proven experience with GoHighLevel, AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), Google Workspace, Canva, and executive assistance



TECHNICAL AND WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

• Laptop or desktop with at least a 10th-gen i5 processor and 16 GB RAM

• High-speed and stable internet connection

• A backup internet connection (strongly preferred)

• Quiet, professional workspace (dual monitor strongly preferred)

• Noise-canceling headset

• Backup power source or a contingency plan for outages (strongly preferred)



COMPENSATION

• $7 per hour

• Paid bi-weekly

• Payment cycle: every 10 working days



HOW TO APPLY

• Please use ZT as your subject line and use 10 AP points.

• Submit a link to your CV/Portfolio using Google Drive.

• Include a short video recording of yourself speaking in English. Introduce yourself, explain why you would be a good fit, and include any relevant work experience.

• Make sure we can access and view the file. We won't request access.



IMPORTANT

• Applicants who do not follow the instructions will be immediately disqualified and will not receive a reply.



HIRING PROCESS

• Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

• Qualified applicants will be invited for a 30-minute to 1-hour interview.



If you are looking for a stable, long-term role with room to grow your skills and increase your compensation over time, we look forward to reviewing your application.

title: AI App Developer
description:
AI Agency Institute

We’re Hiring!



AI App Developer



Full-Time  |  Remote  |  $15–$25/hr AUD



About Us

AI Agency Institute is at the forefront of building AI-powered applications and solutions. We leverage cutting-edge tools like Claude AI and Claude Code to rapidly develop intelligent apps for our clients. We’re a fast-moving, innovation-driven team looking for a talented developer to help us scale our growing portfolio of AI applications.



The Role

We’re looking for a mid-level developer who can take the AI-powered apps we’ve been prototyping with Claude Code and build them out into polished, production-ready products. You’ll work closely with our team to turn concepts into fully functional applications, improve existing builds, and help us push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI-assisted development.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Build out and refine AI-powered applications initially developed with Claude Code

• Develop full-stack web applications (frontend and backend) from concept to deployment

• Work with AI tools and APIs (Claude AI, OpenAI, and similar) to integrate intelligent features into apps

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code

• Collaborate with the team to translate ideas and prototypes into production-ready software

• Debug, test, and optimise applications for performance and reliability

• Stay current with AI development tools and best practices



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of experience in web/software development

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar languages

• Experience with modern frameworks (React, Next.js, Node.js, or equivalent)

• Familiarity with AI/LLM APIs and tools (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) — experience with Claude Code is a big plus

• Comfortable working with APIs, databases, and cloud services (AWS, Vercel, Supabase, etc.)

• Ability to take loosely defined concepts and turn them into working software

• Strong problem-solving skills and a self-starter mindset

• Excellent written communication in English



Nice to Have

• Experience with prompt engineering and AI-assisted development workflows

• Background in building SaaS products or client-facing applications

• Familiarity with no-code/low-code tools alongside traditional development

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps basics

• Portfolio or GitHub showcasing personal or professional projects



Compensation & Benefits

• $15–$25/hr AUD depending on experience and skill level

• Full-time, remote position — work from anywhere

• Opportunity to work at the cutting edge of AI application development

• Collaborative, flexible team environment

• Room to grow as we scale our projects and client base



How to Apply



Send us your application with the following:

• Your updated resume/CV

• A brief cover letter explaining why you’re a great fit for this role

• Links to your portfolio

• Any experience you have working with AI tools (especially Claude or Claude Code)



We’re excited to hear from you! If you’re passionate about building with AI and ready to join a team that’s shaping the future of intelligent applications, apply now.

title: Admissions Operations Coordinator (Part Time, Remote)
description:
Guaranteed 5 hours per week, with room to grow.

*Applications will be reviewed as they are received. The posting may close early once we have enough strong candidates.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely enjoys creating calm from chaos.



I run a university admissions consultancy based between Singapore and South Korea, helping ambitious students around the world navigate applications to top universities. I work with 15-20 students per year, and meet with them online frequently across multiple time zones- usually in the early evening SGT. My students rely on consistent structure, thoughtful follow through, and reliable communication.



Right now, I'm the bottleneck. If I forget to send a reminder, a student may miss a meeting. If I don't follow up, things stall. My goal is to build an admissions operation that runs smoothly without depending on me remembering every detail.



I'm looking for someone who wants to own that system.



What success looks like- Within your first 90 days:



-Every active student always has their next meeting scheduled.

-Students receive personalized reminders before every meeting that include the key action item from our previous session.

-No-shows caused by missed reminders are close to zero.

-Students are replied to promptly within business hours (10-7 SGT, Monday-Saturday)

-We always know who might need a new meeting and who is on pause via an updated student tracker.

-Quiet students are followed up with proactively.

-I have more time to focus on growing the business instead of chasing logistics.



What you'll do



Student scheduling



Schedule and reschedule student meetings across multiple time zones. (Typically KST, SGT, and EU time zones)

Keep every student booked for their next session.

Manage my calendar and meeting availability.

Set up first meetings and group chats for new students.



Student reminders



Send timely, reliable pre-meeting reminders via Whatsapp business.

Review Zoom summaries and identify the action item that actually matters.

Remove completed or vague tasks.

Personalize reminders so students know exactly what they should do before we meet.

Adjust reminders for online versus in-person meetings.



Student follow through



Follow up with students who have gone quiet.

Notice when someone hasn't met recently and bring it to my attention.

Help keep students moving through the admissions process.



Operations



Maintain our student tracker.

Update meeting dates, student status, and lead information.

Record Common App application information.



Keeping me on track



Own a recurring rhythm of business reminders — invoicing dates, client follow-ups, payroll, renewals — so nothing slips through the cracks.

Nudge me when something is due, and follow up (kindly but persistently) until it's actually done.

Flag when I've dropped a ball, before it becomes a problem.

(This starts as reminders and prompts. Over time, as we build trust, some of these tasks can move fully onto your plate.)



Growth support



Monitor university admissions and education networking events in my area.

Keep track of networking contacts and remind me when it's time to reconnect.

Respond to new family inquiries on WhatsApp Business and schedule discovery calls.

Help maintain a simple, consistent LinkedIn posting rhythm.



You'll probably thrive if...



-You never need someone to remind you to send a reminder.

-You naturally notice when something doesn't look right.

-You'd rather ask one thoughtful question than make a bad assumption.

-You enjoy systems- and making systems reliable.

-You communicate promptly, clearly, and kindly.

-You can juggle multiple time zones without getting flustered.

-You care about helping young people succeed.

-You're comfortable nudging me and following up until things get done — you won't let me off the hook.



What matters most



I'm much more interested in how you work than the number of years on your resume.



The qualities I'm looking for are:



-Reliability. You consistently do routine tasks well without letting things slip.

-Judgment. You can sort through messy information and identify what actually matters.

-Ownership. You notice problems before they become someone else's problem.

-Communication. You write warm, clear, natural English messages that people respond to.



Nice to have



Experience working with students, families, education, or admissions.

Experience supporting founders or small businesses.

An eye for LinkedIn content or social media.



Tools you'll use- Comfort with these matters more than years of experience:



Google Calendar for scheduling.

Zoom (reviewing meeting summaries).

WhatsApp Business for student and family communication.

Google Sheets for our tracker.



You don't need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be comfortable learning them quickly.



Time zone



I'm based in Seoul (KST), but I often travel to Singapore and other countries. Reminders and scheduling need to reliably land on time in Singapore’s time zone, since most of my students are based there. You can work your own hours as long as nothing slips — some overlap with my working day is a plus but not required.



Hours & compensation



Guaranteed 5 hours per week to start, with flexibility around when those hours are worked, and room for the role to grow as we build systems together.



Hourly contractor position, $10–15 USD/hour depending on experience.





To apply, please send:



-Your resume.

-A short video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself and answering:

-Why does this role interest you?

-Tell me about a repetitive process you've owned successfully. How did you make sure nothing slipped?

-Your current time zone and your typical working hours.



Please begin your application with the word "Lighthouse" so I know you've read this posting all the way through.



*Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical exercise (around 30–45 minutes, paid at the role's hourly rate) based on real work from the role. I believe seeing how someone works is a much better predictor of success than multiple rounds of interviews.



Applications close July 25th.



If you're the kind of person who gets satisfaction from making complex operations run smoothly, I'd love to hear from you.

Quote Genie is a U.S.-based telemarketing company that connects interested consumers with licensed insurance professionals. Our team contacts leads provided by our clients, identifies prospects who are interested in receiving an insurance quote, and transfers qualified prospects directly to the client.



We are looking for a dependable, confident, and results-driven telemarketer who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls.

As a Live Transfer Specialist, you will contact U.S.-based insurance prospects using our dialing system. Your responsibility is to follow the approved script, determine whether the prospect is interested in receiving an insurance quote, and successfully transfer qualified prospects to our clients.

* Approximately 40 paid hours per week

title: AI Research & Knowledge Organization Assistant
description:
About the Project



We're building a large-scale practical preparedness encyclopedia.



The project involves transforming thousands of existing documents into a clear, organized, easy-to-read encyclopedia. This is not copywriting or content marketing. It is a knowledge organization project.



You'll be using AI tools to analyze groups of source documents, identify the important information, remove duplication, reorganize the material into a logical structure, and produce well-written, professional looking, ready to go out encyclopedia chapters. Outputting the text information directly from AI into a Google Doc is not what we're looking for; it needs to be formatted appropriately and include relevant tables, charts, images, branding, etc. 



If you enjoy research, organization, and working with AI, this is a fascinating project.



Responsibilities

Your work will include:

- Reading and organizing groups of PDF documents.

- Using AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, or similar) to analyze source material.

- Combining information from multiple documents into a single coherent chapter.

- Removing duplicate information while preserving important details.

- Organizing information into a predefined chapter structure.

- Producing clear, factual, neutral encyclopedia-style writing.

- Following detailed formatting and style guides.

- Maintaining consistency across many chapters.

- Revising chapters based on feedback.



This job is not:

Blog writing

SEO writing

Marketing copy

Social media management

Creative writing



The goal is to organize knowledge—not create new information.



Required skills you should have:

Excellent written English.

Exceptional attention to detail.

Strong organizational skills.

Confidence using AI tools for research and writing.

The ability to follow detailed instructions consistently.

Good judgment when combining information from multiple sources.

The ability to produce clean, aesthetic, well-structured documents.



These are not required but would be highly valued:

Experience with NotebookLM, Claude, or ChatGPT.

Technical writing experience.

Experience creating manuals or documentation.

Experience organizing large knowledge bases.

Interest in preparedness, outdoor skills, engineering, science, or practical education.



You should enjoy:

Organizing information.

Making complicated topics easy to understand.

Creating order from large amounts of information.

Learning new AI workflows.

Working independently.

Producing high-quality work.



You are naturally curious, methodical, and take pride in accuracy.



Trial Project:

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial project.

You will receive a small collection of source documents and a chapter outline.

Your task will be to use AI to transform those documents into a polished encyclopedia chapter following our style guide.

This is a paid assessment. I'm interested in your process just as much as your final result.



Working Relationship

Work will be project-based with flexible hours. 



Clear communication, reliability, and consistency are more important than speed.



How to Apply:

Please include the following in your application:



A brief introduction about yourself.

Which AI tools you use regularly.

A short description of the most complex project you've completed using AI.

Why you think you'd enjoy this type of work.

Include the phrase "Knowledge is organized, not created." somewhere in your application so I know you've read the entire posting.

If available, provide examples of technical writing, documentation, manuals, research summaries, or other structured writing you've produced.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.

title: Senior Python Automation Engineer – AI-Powered Lead Generation Platform (Experienced Developers Only)
description:
# Senior Python Automation Engineer – AI-Powered Lead Generation Platform (Experienced Developers Only)



We are seeking an experienced **Senior Python Automation Engineer** to design and build a **production-grade lead generation platform** for **STR Revenue**, a company specializing in revenue management solutions for short-term rental operators.



This is a high-level development project that requires an experienced software engineer with a proven background in large-scale automation, web scraping, lead generation, backend architecture, and production deployments.



**Please read this carefully before applying.**



This opportunity is **strictly for experienced developers**. We are **not** looking for beginners, junior developers, trainees, agencies that outsource work to inexperienced developers, or applicants seeking a learning opportunity.



If you have never built a production-ready lead generation platform or similar automation system, **please do not apply.**



---



## Project Overview



The goal of this project is to replace our current manual lead generation workflow with a fully automated platform capable of discovering Airbnb hosts and small hotel owners, collecting publicly available business contact information, organizing qualified leads into a centralized database, and launching professional outbound
 campaigns.



The final product must be designed for long-term production use with an emphasis on:



* Reliability

* Speed

* Scalability

* Maintainability

* Security

* Clean architecture

* Ease of future expansion



This is not simply a web scraper. We are looking for someone capable of building a complete automation platform from the ground up.



---



## Lead Discovery Engine



The platform should automatically:



* Search Airbnb listings by city, state, ZIP code, or region.

* Discover Airbnb hosts and vacation rental owners.

* Locate publicly available business websites.

* Discover publicly available business social media profiles.

* Identify publicly available contact pages.

* Continuously discover and add new qualified leads to the database.



The system should be intelligent, efficient, and capable of running continuously with minimal supervision.



---



## Contact Discovery & Enrichment



Once a lead has been identified, the platform should gather publicly available business information whenever available, including:



* Business name

* Host name

* Business
 address

* Website

* Phone number

* Property location

* Social media profiles

* Source URL

* Lead verification status



The system should also support integration with third-party contact enrichment services to improve lead quality whenever appropriate.



---



## Lead Management Dashboard



Develop a modern web dashboard where users can:



* Search leads instantly

* Filter by location

* Filter by verification status

* View complete lead profiles

* Remove duplicate records

* Export data to CSV

* View lead generation analytics

* Monitor system activity



The interface should be clean, responsive, and designed for daily business use.



---



##
 Campaign Platform



The system should integrate with professional
 providers such as:



* Resend (preferred)

* Amazon SES

* Mailgun

* SendGrid



Features should include:



* Bulk
 campaigns

* Personalized
 templates

* Campaign scheduling

* Open tracking

* Click tracking

* Bounce monitoring

* Unsubscribe handling

* Consultation booking links

* Campaign reporting



---



## Automation



The platform should support automated workflows including:



* Daily lead discovery

* Automatic lead updates

* Contact verification

* Duplicate detection

*
 campaign queuing

* Scheduled reporting

* Background processing



The objective is to minimize manual work while maintaining high-quality data.



---



## Preferred Technology Stack



### Backend



* Python

* FastAPI

* PostgreSQL

* Redis

* Background workers

* REST APIs



### Frontend



* React

* Responsive UI

* Secure authentication

* Role-based access control



### Infrastructure



Experience integrating with:



* Resend

* Amazon SES

* Mailgun

* SendGrid



Experience deploying production systems to cloud environments is highly preferred.



---



## Required Qualifications



Applicants must demonstrate strong experience in the following:



* Production-grade Python development

* Web scraping and browser automation

* Large-scale lead generation systems

* Backend architecture

* Database design

* API integrations

* Asynchronous programming

* Background job processing

* Proxy management and rate limiting

* Duplicate detection

* Contact validation

* Building scalable SaaS applications



You should be capable of writing clean, maintainable, well-documented code and making sound architectural decisions without constant guidance.



---



## What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who thinks like an engineer—not just a programmer.



You should be able to recommend better technical solutions when appropriate, identify potential bottlenecks before they become problems, and build software that is designed to scale rather than simply function.



Communication is important. We value developers who ask thoughtful questions, provide progress updates, and take ownership of their work.



---



## To Apply



Your proposal **must include**:



* A brief introduction about yourself.

* A summary of your relevant experience.

* Examples of similar automation or lead generation systems you have developed.

* The technologies and frameworks you used.

* Your recommended technical approach for this project.

* Estimated development timeline.

* Your fixed-price quote or hourly rate.



Applications that consist of generic AI-generated proposals, copy-and-paste introductions, or provide no evidence of relevant experience will be ignored.



---



## Important



This project will only be awarded to a developer with demonstrable experience building production-ready automation systems.



We are looking for a long-term technical partner who can deliver a stable, scalable, and maintainable platform—not someone who is experimenting or learning as they go.



If you have the experience, confidence, and technical ability to build this platform to a professional standard, we would love to hear from you.

title: Business Systems & Automation Manager
description:
GoHighLevel, Automation & Digital Marketing



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Leadership Opportunity



We are a growing U.S.-based company looking for a highly capable and resourceful person who can help us build the systems, automation, and digital marketing infrastructure needed to scale our business.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant position.



We are looking for a hands-on problem solver who can work directly with the company owner, understand our business goals, and turn ideas into practical systems and measurable results.



The right person will begin by taking ownership of GoHighLevel, business automation, and digital marketing. As the company grows, this role has the potential to develop into a senior leadership or executive-level position.



About the Company



Quick Cash Phone is a growing Texas-based mobile device sales and customer financing company with multiple retail locations.



Our business includes:



- Retail mobile device sales

- Customer financing

- Lead generation

- WhatsApp communication

- CRM and pipeline management

- Customer follow-up

- Digital advertising

- Payment management

- Sales and employee performance tracking



We are currently building a more organized and scalable operating system using GoHighLevel, automation tools, digital marketing, and artificial intelligence.



The person hired for this role will have the opportunity to become one of the early key members helping shape these systems.



The Opportunity



This position is for someone who wants more than a routine remote job.



You will work closely with the business owner and management team to improve how the company attracts customers, manages leads, communicates with customers, tracks performance, and operates internally.



You will have significant freedom to recommend better tools, suggest new strategies, and build solutions.



We do not expect one person to be an expert in every technical and marketing platform.



However, we are looking for someone who has strong experience in our core areas, learns quickly, takes initiative, and knows how to research or coordinate additional support when a project requires more advanced development.



As the company expands, strong performance in this role could lead to:



- Increased responsibility

- Management of future tea
mbers

- Higher compensation

- Profit-based incentives

- A senior leadership position

- A possible future executive role



Career advancement will be based on performance, ownership, trust, and the measurable value created for the company.



Core Responsibilities

1. GoHighLevel and CRM Management

Build and improve GoHighLevel pipelines, workflows, forms, triggers, and automations

Organize leads and customer information inside the CRM

Create automated follow-up through WhatsApp, SMS,
, and internal notifications

Improve lead assignment and lead-tracking processes

Maintain clean and accurate CRM data

Monitor workflows and troubleshoot problems



2. Business Automation

Use Zapier, Make, webhooks, Google Sheets, and other tools to connect business systems

Identify repetitive manual tasks that can be automated

Build practical automations for leads, sales, reporting, customer follow-up, and operations

Test all automations before deployment

Monitor and maintain existing workflows

Document important systems and procedures

Recommend software and tools that can improve efficiency



Advanced programming is not required.



However, basic knowledge of APIs, webhooks, or low-code tools is highly valuable. For highly technical projects, you may help us find, communicate with, and manage an outside developer.



3. Digital Marketing (Plus, Not a Requirement)

Manage and improve
 and Instagram advertising campaigns

Assist with TikTok advertising and organic content strategy

Create, test, and optimize lead-generation campaigns

Connect advertising campaigns to GoHighLevel forms, pipelines, and follow-up systems

Monitor campaign performance, lead quality, and conversion rates

Help develop new advertising ideas and promotional offers

Coordinate basic creative production using Canva, AI tools, or outside designers

Maintain company social media pages and advertising accounts

Identify why campaigns are or are not producing qualified leads

Improve the complete process from advertisement to lead to sale



We are not looking only for someone who can post content.



We want someone who understands that marketing performance should be measured through leads, appointments, conversations, sales, and return on advertising spend.





Initial Priorities



During the first several months, the main priorities will be:



- Learn how our company currently operates

- Organize and improve our GoHighLevel account

- Build reliable lead follow-up and notification workflows

- Connect forms, WhatsApp, advertising, and CRM pipelines

- Improve
 and Instagram lead-generation campaigns

- Create simple reports that show lead sources and sales results

- Identify the most valuable opportunities for additional automation



You will not be expected to rebuild every company system immediately.



We want someone who can prioritize the highest-impact projects and improve the company step by step.



Required Experience



Candidates should have strong experience in several of the following areas:



- GoHighLevel

- CRM administration

- Zapier or Make

- Workflow automation

-
 and Instagram advertising

- Lead-generation campaigns

- Social media marketing

- Google Sheets

- WhatsApp Business

- Meta Business Manager

- AI tools such as ChatGPT

- Landing pages and online forms

- Marketing performance reporting



Experience with every tool is not required.



The ability to think logically, learn independently, and solve problems is more important than having a long list of software certifications.



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate:



- Is a hands-on builder, not only a manager

- Understands both business operations and digital marketing

- Can work independently without waiting for detailed instructions

- Looks for opportunities to improve the company

- Can explain technical and marketing issues clearly

- Is comfortable testing ideas and analyzing results

- Takes responsibility when a system or campaign is not working

- Is interested in growing with one company for several years

- Wants the opportunity to become a key member of a growing organization

- Understands when to build something personally and when to recommend outside expertise



Your previous title may have been:



- GoHighLevel Specialist

- Marketing Automation Specialist

- CRM Manager

- Business Systems Specialist

- Operations and Automation Manager

- No-Code Developer



Your title is less important than your ability to create real business results.



This Position Is Not for You If



- You only perform tasks when given detailed step-by-step instructions

- Your experience is limited to basic data entry

- You have only used prebuilt automation templates

- You cannot explain how your work generated leads, sales, or operational improvements

- You are uncomfortable troubleshooting problems

- You frequently disappear or fail to communicate

- You are currently working multiple full-time jobs

- You are only interested in short-term freelance projects

- You want a management title but do not want to perform hands-on work



Work Schedule



This is intended to become a full-time, long-term position.

The candidate must be available for meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours.



We may begin with a paid trial period before transitioning into a permanent full-time role.



Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience, technical ability, marketing knowledge, and demonstrated results.



We are prepared to pay up to $15 USD per hour for an exceptional candidate who can take ownership of both our business systems and growth initiatives.



Higher compensation and performance-based incentives may become available as the candidate demonstrates results and takes on greater responsibility.



Paid Trial



Qualified candidates may be invited to complete a paid trial project.



The project may include:



- Reviewing our existing GoHighLevel setup

- Identifying problems or missing automation

- Recommending a lead-management workflow

- Reviewing a current marketing campaign

- Building a small automation

- Creating a simple campaign and reporting plan



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate your thinking, communication, execution, and ability to understand our business.



How to Apply



Please include the following:



- A brief introduction

- Why this position interests you

- Your experience with GoHighLevel

- Your experience with Zapier, Make, or other automation tools

- Your experience managing
, Instagram, or TikTok marketing

- Two examples of systems or automations you personally built

- One example of a marketing campaign you personally managed

- The results of that campaign, including leads, sales, conversion rates, or return on ad spend when available

- Your current availability

- Your desired hourly rate

- A portfolio, Loom video, screenshots, or other proof of your work

- Your WhatsApp number







You may also contact us through WhatsApp at:




We are looking for someone who wants to build, improve, and grow with the company—not simply complete assigned tasks.



For the right person, this can become a long-term career and an opportunity to become an important leader within our organization.

 communications and rewards. 



As the Loyalty and Direct Marketing Manager, you will play a vital role in building strong relationships with customers and maximising their lifetime value to the business. Your strategic thinking, data-driven approach, and creative flair will be crucial in driving customer loyalty and engagement through well-executed
 marketing campaigns and loyalty initiatives. Key responsibilities include:



 Marketing Campaigns:

Plan and execute

Create compelling and engaging
 content, including newsletters, promotional offers, event invitations, and product updates.

 campaigns.

Monitor and analyse
 performance metrics to identify areas of improvement and inform future strategies.

Develop and implement customer loyalty strategies and programs to increase customer retention and repeat purchases.

Analyse customer data to identify trends, preferences, and opportunities for improving loyalty initiatives.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement loyalty program enhancements, promotions, and rewards.

Data Analysis and Reporting:

Prepare reports and presentations to communicate results and progress to stakeholders.



Compliance and Best Practices:

Stay up-to-date with industry best practices and trends in loyalty programs and
 marketing.

Prepare and manage budgets ensuring financial resources are allocated efficiently and in line with organisational objectives.

Monitor budget variances and implement cost-saving measures where applicable.

title: eCommerce CX & Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Must work U.S. Eastern Time hours | $12–18/hr USD depending on experience



About the role



We're a growing Shopify DTC brand. We're hiring one person to build our customer experience function, keep our Shopify catalog accurate and current, and manage our day-to-day relationship with our 3PL.



This is a builder role. The helpdesk exists (Gorgias, including an AI agent) but the function — the team, the playbook, the standards — is yours to create. We use AI daily (Claude is part of our stack) and expect you to use it the same way: drafting, documenting, and automating repetitive work.



What you'll own



The CX function

> Build it: hire, train, and manage a small remote support team as we grow — starting hands-on in the queue yourself

Run Gorgias as a system: macros, rules, tagging, SLAs, AI agent configuration, and reporting

> Set the standard: brand voice in every reply, documented SOPs for every scenario, escalation paths that don't route through the founder

> TikTok Shop CX: platform SLAs, disputes, seller-score protection



The Shopify catalog — you are the source of truth

> Upload and edit products: titles, descriptions, images, variants, pricing, tags, collections

> Keep the catalog accurate: if it's wrong on the site, it's yours to catch and fix

> Execute launches and updates handed to you by the founder/marketing — quickly, completely, and without errors





The 3PL relationship

> Day-to-day liaison with our 3PL via ShipHero: order holds, address changes, returns, and shipment issues chased to resolution

> Investigate inventory discrepancies between Shopify and the warehouse and get the counts corrected

> Flag fulfillment problems (delays, packaging, receiving errors) early — with what happened, what you did, and what you need





Weekly reporting — you keep leadership informed without being asked

> Deliver a weekly CX + operations report covering: tickets opened/closed and resolution times, CSAT, orders shipped and delivered, recurring product issues (defects, sizing, damage-in-transit patterns), returns, and open fulfillment problems with their status

> Numbers plus judgment: not just what happened, but what's trending, what you fixed, and what needs a decision from leadership

> Use Claude and the reporting built into Gorgias/Shopify/ShipHero to produce this efficiently — the report should take you an hour, not an afternoon





How we measure success

> CX: first-response and resolution times within SLA, CSAT, and recurring ticket types reduced through better macros, help content, and SOPs. 

> Catalog: zero-error product listings and fast turnaround on uploads and edits. 

> Fulfillment: issues resolved without founder involvement, and inventory counts we can trust. Reporting: a weekly report delivered on time, every week, that leadership can act on without asking follow-up questions.



Requirements

> Experience running customer support for a Shopify eCommerce brand, including hiring or training support staff

> Builder-level Gorgias experience: rules, automations, tagging, AI agent — not just replying to tickets

> Hands-on Shopify catalog work: you've personally created and edited products, variants, and collections

> Experience working with a 3PL or warehouse (ShipHero strongly preferred)

> Experience producing regular reports for leadership (CX and/or operations metrics)

> Daily, practical use of AI tools in your real work

> Excellent written English — this is a writing-heavy role

> Reliable availability during U.S. Eastern business hours





How we hire

Application form ? short interview ? paid practical exercise using realistic scenarios from our actual store ? reference checks. 



Please note: when the application form asks where you heard about this role, answer "Joy" — this helps us track applications correctly. We verify everything claimed in the application during the interview and exercise, so be precise about what you personally did versus what your team did.

title: Performance Creative Designer — AXL Media
description:
Full-time | Fully Remote | Melbourne Time (AEST/AEDT) | Start ASAP | 



We're on the hunt for a Performance Creative Designer who knows how to make an ad stop the scroll and convert.

You'll produce video, static, and motion assets for automotive brands across Meta, Google, TikTok, and LinkedIn, working from performance briefs and driven by data, not just design instinct.

If you think in hooks, test relentlessly, and use AI as a tool rather than a crutch, this one's for you.



Who we are

AXL Media is an attribution-first marketing agency for automotive brands. We work with over 100 dealerships and motor groups across Australia and New Zealand, from single-rooftop dealers to 20-brand groups.

Most agencies optimise for their own metrics: impressions, clicks, engagement. We optimise for our clients' metrics: leads, sales, cost per car sold. If the data doesn't point to dealership revenue, we're not done yet.



Why this role matters

Performance marketing lives and dies by its creative. Targeting, budget, and bidding strategy mean nothing if the asset doesn't stop the scroll.

We need someone who understands what makes a paid ad perform and has the craft to execute it across every channel we run for clients. You'll turn briefs into assets that drive real results: lower CPAs, stronger ROAS, and creative our clients are proud of.



The role

We're looking for a Performance Creative Designer to join our performance marketing team, working fully remote, full-time.

You'll produce video, static, and motion assets for paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and beyond, working from briefs developed by our account leads across our portfolio of auto brands.

You think about hooks, stop rates, scroll behaviour, and how creative interacts with the funnel. You test, iterate, and improve based on what the data tells you, and stay across trends on organic channels and in the market.



Key responsibilities



Creative production

Produce high-quality video edits, static ads, and motion graphics for paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, and other paid channels.

Work from performance briefs to create assets that are on-brand, channel-appropriate, and built to convert.

Adapt and repurpose creative across formats, aspect ratios, and placements efficiently.

Maintain fast turnaround without compromising craft or quality.



Performance thinking

Build creative with a clear understanding of what drives performance: strong hooks, thumb-stopping visuals, and clear CTAs.

Understand the role of click-through behaviour in evaluating creative effectiveness.

Contribute ideas for creative testing: new angles, formats, hooks, and approaches.

Review performance data with the accounts team and apply learnings to future creative.



Creative testing and iteration

Support a structured approach to creative testing across accounts, producing variants and testing hypotheses.

Help build a library of winning creative patterns, hooks, and formats for clients like Volvo, Porsche, Nissan, and Ford.

Stay across platform creative best practices and emerging trends on Meta, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn.



Collaboration and workflow

Work closely with account leads to understand client goals, audience, and channel strategy.

Raise questions early when briefs are unclear rather than producing work that misses the mark.

Create and manage your own production queue with ownership and good communication.

Contribute to a creative culture that values quality and output.



On AI and tools

We encourage the use of AI tools as part of your production workflow. AI is a legitimate execution accelerant for ideation, copy drafting, asset editing, and iteration speed.

It is not a replacement for creative judgement, performance intuition, or strategic thinking. Work that is clearly AI-generated without human craft behind it won't meet our bar.



Success in this role looks like

High-quality creative output delivered consistently and on time across multiple client accounts.

Assets that perform, improving CTR, CPC, and CPL across campaigns.

A growing library of tested creative learnings applied to future briefs.

Strong working relationships with the performance and account teams.

Creative that clients are proud of and that the team is proud to put out.



You'll likely be a strong fit if you

Have hands-on experience creating paid ads for performance campaigns (design experience for Meta Ads and Google Ads is essential).

Understand what makes an ad stop the scroll, and why that matters more than what looks pretty.

Know your way around video editing, motion, and static ad production.

Have worked in or alongside a performance marketing team and understand how creative ties to results.

Are fast, organised, and take ownership of your output.

Use AI tools as part of your workflow without letting them replace your own thinking.

Care about craft and impact in equal measure.



Experience we'd value

2+ years producing creative assets specifically for paid digital advertising.

Strong proficiency in video editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar).

Solid design skills across static and motion formats (After Effects, Figma, Photoshop, Canva).

Demonstrated understanding of platform-native creative: Meta Reels, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Google Display.

Experience with creative testing frameworks and iterating based on performance data.

Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.

Familiarity with performance metrics: CTR, ROAS, CPL, CPC.



Why join AXL Media

Join an award-winning agency with strong 
ntum.

Work within a performance marketing team that takes creative seriously as a growth lever.

Real ownership over your work and its impact on client outcomes.

Work with a high-quality team and automotive client base.

Build something meaningful in a business that values standards, trust, and good humans.



How to apply

Send your CV and portfolio (or reel link) to 

Use the subject line: Performance Creative Designer Application — [Your Name]

Include your expected rate or salary in your application.

title: UGC & Influencer Coordinator

UGC & Influencer Coordinator



About the Role



Natralus Australia is seeking a creative and organised UGC & Influencer Coordinator to help grow our presence across TikTok and YouTube while building meaningful relationships with influencers and content creators.



Working closely with the Senior Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging creators, coordinating influencer collaborations, creating and editing short-form video content, publishing content to TikTok and YouTube, and reporting on platform performance.



This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys social media, creator engagement and video content, with strong organisational and communication skills.



Responsibilities



Influencer Outreach & Relationship Coordination



- Research and identify micro influencers and content creators across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube who align with the Natralus brand.

- Conduct influencer outreach and manage creator communications.

- Coordinate influencer product gifting campaigns and collaboration logistics.

- Negotiate collaboration deliverables and timelines where required.

- Build and maintain positive, long-term relationships with influencers and creators.

- Maintain an organised database of creators, communications and campaign activity.



Content Coordination



- Coordinate influencer content from briefing through to delivery.

- Ensure agreed content is received within required timeframes.

- Review submitted content against campaign requirements before forwarding for approval.

- Create and edit engaging short-form video content using CapCut or similar editing software.

- Prepare video assets suitable for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



TikTok & YouTube Content



- Publish approved content to the Natralus TikTok and YouTube channels.

- Write platform-appropriate titles, captions and descriptions to optimise content for discoverability.

- Monitor audience engagement and respond to comments where appropriate.

- Supply edited video assets for use on Instagram Reels. (Instagram strategy, publishing and management are handled by the Senior Marketing Manager.)



Analytics & Reporting



- Monitor TikTok and YouTube performance.

- Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering audience growth, reach, engagement and video performance.

- Track influencer content performance and provide insights to support future collaborations.

- Identify trends and recommend opportunities to improve content performance across TikTok and YouTube.



Marketing Support



- Support influencer marketing activities and creator partnerships.

- Stay up to date with TikTok, YouTube and creator platform trends.

- Research new creators, emerging content formats and industry trends.

- Assist with creator product requests and campaign administration.

- Provide general support to the marketing team as required.



Requirements



- Experience in influencer outreach, creator partnerships or social media coordination.

- Strong understanding of TikTok, YouTube and Instagram creator ecosystems.

- Excellent written English and verbal communication skills.

- Confident building relationships with influencers and creators.

- Experience creating and editing short-form video content using CapCut or similar software.

- Working knowledge of TikTok and YouTube publishing tools.

- Experience interpreting TikTok and YouTube analytics.

- Strong organisational and time management skills with excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple creator relationships and projects simultaneously.

- Proactive, creative and passionate about social media and emerging digital trends.



Desirable



- Experience working with consumer brands, skincare, health or wellness products.

- Experience using Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

- Understanding of influencer marketing best practices and current social media trends.

title: Inside Sales Representative / Closer (Wholesale)
description:
Hours: Must overlap US business hours for live calls — Los Angeles, CA USA Pacific Standard Timezone



ABOUT THE ROLE



We’re a US-based wholesale closeout and liquidation company. We’re hiring an experienced inside sales rep to own our introductory sales calls and deal flow. Our lead specialist sources and qualifies buyers; you take qualified prospects, run the intro call, build trust, and hand them to the owner warm and ready for negotiation.



This is a brand-new seat, so your calendar won’t be full on day one. While we ramp it up, you’ll work alongside our lead specialist on prospecting and outreach — they’ll train you on that side. But to be clear: we are hiring you for your sales ability. Lead gen is what you’ll help with during downtime; closing-quality conversations are the job.



This is not a generic VA role. It’s a real sales seat with a clear path and strong upside for someone who can perform.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



 • Run introductory video/phone calls with pre-qualified buyers

 • Confidently handle skepticism about supply chain and sourcing without overpromising

 • Distribute deal sheets to qualified buyers as inventory becomes available

 • Maintain clean prospect records and write accurate handoff notes for the owner

 • Set the owner up to negotiate and close — you do NOT negotiate price or close yourself

 • During ramp-up: assist the lead specialist with outreach and qualification (training provided)



WHO YOU ARE (REQUIRED)



 • Experience in US-account phone sales — inside sales, SDR/closing, or high-tier retention/collections

 • Excellent spoken English: clear, neutral, and easily understood by US buyers — confident and composed under pressure (verified by recording and live test)

 • Stays calm and persuasive when challenged or interrupted — does not fold

 • Comfortable on camera

 • Reliable US-hours overlap, stable internet, quiet environment, quality headset

 • Knows when to stop selling and hand off — disciplined, not a freelancer who improvises



NICE TO HAVE



 • Experience selling physical goods, wholesale, B2B, or in liquidation/closeout

 • CRM familiarity



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY (applications that skip any step are deleted)



1. Answer this in writing:



A prospect tells you: “Honestly, every liquidation seller I’ve dealt with has burned me on what’s actually in the lots. Why should I trust you?” Write your response to them in 4–6 sentences.



2. Record a short video introduction (REQUIRED).



Record yourself on camera, 60–90 seconds, speaking naturally — not reading a script. Cover:



 • Your name and where you’re based

 • Your US sales experience — what you sold, to whom, for how long

 • One example of a deal or tough customer you turned around

 • Then answer this on the spot, unscripted: “Why should a skeptical buyer trust a liquidation seller they’ve never met?”



Upload to Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube (unlisted) and paste the link. We’re evaluating clarity, confidence, and how you sound handling an unscripted question — not production quality. Phone camera is fine.



3. Also include: your years of US sales experience, what you sold, and your timezone availability for US-hours calls.



Strong candidates will be invited to a live roleplay where you’ll handle a skeptical buyer in real time.

# The Filipino Caller Wealth-Building Opportunity | Rise to 5% VIP Commission and Compete for $10,000



**Remote Philippines Opportunity**

**20 to 40 hours per week | Power dialer provided**



## THIS IS BIGGER THAN AN ORDINARY CALL-CENTER JOB



Most calling jobs pay you for your hours and keep all the upside.



Asset Recovered Team is offering something different.



We provide the leads, skip tracing, software, power dialer, scripts, training, professional closers, and commission tracking.



You bring the voice, discipline, customer service, and persistence.

This is not guaranteed wealth or easy money.



It is a serious opportunity for callers who apply themselves, make the calls, build a pipeline, and produce verified results.



## ENTER A HIDDEN U.S. INDUSTRY



When certain American properties are sold through foreclosure or tax-sale proceedings, the sale can produce more money than is required to pay the debts, taxes, liens, and expenses.



The remaining money may be called:



* Surplus funds

* Excess proceeds

* Overages

* Overbids

* Government refunds



Depending on the law, this money may belong to a former property owner, heir, creditor, or other lawful claimant.



Hundreds of millions of dollars have been described as sitting in government accounts across the United States.



Many eligible people do not know the money exists.



Every recovery begins with someone finding the claimant and starting the conversation.



That person could be you.



## TRAINED THROUGH ATTORNEY BOB DIAMOND’S PROGRAM



The founders of Asset Recovered Team completed the surplus-funds training developed by **Attorney Bob Diamond**, co-founder of Diamond Law Center.



We use **Excess Elite** as our professional backend system to:



* Locate potential claimants

* Provide skip-traced leads

* Operate the power dialer

* Track calls and appointments

* Monitor deals through closing

* Identify which caller originated each claim

* Calculate bonuses and commissions



You are not being handed a random list and left alone.



You are joining a structured nationwide operation.



## WHY THIS OPPORTUNITY EXISTS FOR FILIPINOS



Founder Romeo is American and half Filipino.



His mother came from Cebu and raised two children in the United States as a single mother. She taught him to work hard, finish what he started, and never allow another person to d
 the limit of his value.



Romeo also lived in the Philippines for approximately one year and attended the University of Southern Philippines in Lahug, Cebu.



The Philippines is part of his family, education, and personal history.



Romeo built his career through commission-based work. He learned that hourly pay compensates time, but commission can reward the value a person creates.



That is why this position offers more than a small base salary.



The company earns more when your attributed claims succeed.



You earn more when the company earns more.



## WE INVEST BEFORE YOU MAKE THE FIRST CALL



Asset Recovered Team pays for:



* Leads

* Skip tracing

* Professional software

* CRM access

* Power dialing

* Scripts and training

* Professional closers

* Deal and commission tracking

* Administrative support



You pay no application, training, lead, software, or membership fee.



We provide the system.



You use it to build your pipeline.



## YOUR MISSION



During a full shift, you will make at least:



# 200 OUTBOUND CALL ATTEMPTS



That can equal:



* 1,000 calls per week

* 4,000 calls per month

* 48,000 calls over twelve consistent months



Not every person will answer.



Not every claimant will qualify.



Not every qualified claimant will complete the process.



But every completed deal begins with a caller who made the next call.



You do not provide legal advice or close the final claim.



Your role is to:



* Reach the correct claimant

* Explain the reason for the call

* Ask basic verification questions

* Create interest and trust

* Complete a live transfer

* Book an appointment when necessary

* Enter accurate CRM notes

* Follow up professionally



Our closer handles the detailed consultation and final closing process.



## GET PAID THROUGHOUT THE PROCESS



### Base Pay



* $1 USD per hour

* 20 to 40 scheduled hours per week

* Full-time and part-time opportunities



### Weekly Performance Bonus



Earn an additional **$10 per week** for meeting attendance, call-volume, CRM-accuracy, and quality requirements.



### Call Bonuses



You may earn:



* **$1 for an accepted live transfer or qualified appointment**

* **Additional $1 when the claimant is confirmed as qualified**

* **Additional $1 when a scheduled claimant attends**



A productive claimant can generate up to **$3 in immediate bonuses** before the claim is completed.



## EARN $100 FOR EVERY COMPLETED DEAL



When a claimant you originate completes the recovery process and Asset Recovered Team receives cleared funds, you earn:



# $100 PER COMPLETED AND COLLECTED DEAL



This is paid in addition to your percentage commission.



## CLIMB THE COMMISSION LEVELS



Every month begins at Gold.



Your highest level applies retroactively to all qualifying company fees collected from your attributed deals during that month.



### GOLD: ONE COMPLETED DEAL



* 2% commission

* $100 completed-deal bonus



### PLATINUM: TWO COMPLETED DEALS



* 3% commission on both deals

* $200 in completed-deal bonuses



### DIAMOND: THREE COMPLETED DEALS



* 4% commission on all three deals

* $300 in completed-deal bonuses



### VIP: FOUR OR MORE COMPLETED DEALS



* 5% commission on every qualifying deal collected that month

* $100 bonus for every completed deal



The level resets at the beginning of each month.



Commission is based on the fee Asset Recovered Team actually collects, not the claimant’s total recovery.



## SEE WHAT FOUR DEALS CAN PRODUCE

* Four weekly performance bonuses: $40

## HIGHER-VALUE VIP EXAMPLE

* Two deals producing $10,000 each



Total company fees collected:

At the VIP Level:

* Monthly base pay: $160

# ILLUSTRATED MONTHLY TOTAL: $4,100



This does not include smaller call bonuses.



These are mathematical illustrations, not guaranteed or typical earnings. Results depend on qualified claimants, completed recoveries, collected company fees, attribution, and individual performance.



## COMPETE FOR THE TOP



Qualified callers may compete for annual performance prizes:

* **$5,000 prize**

Meeting the minimum does not automatically win the prize. Final placement is determined under the written leaderboard rules.



A separate Christmas or year-end bonus may also be considered based on performance and company results. It is discretionary and not guaranteed.



## TWO CALLERS. TWO DIFFERENT FUTURES.



Both callers receive the same leads.



Both receive the same software, training, script, and closing team.



The first caller becomes discouraged after unanswered calls and rejection.



The second caller keeps moving.

That next call could become:

## WHO SHOULD APPLY?

I would like to verify that I am speaking with the correct person and connect you with a specialist who can provide additional information.”

title: Biology/Environmental Science Tutor
description:
Job Title: Academic Tutor (Biology / Environmental Studies)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Part-Time

Reports To: Director of Academic Programs



About the Role:

Telos Prep is seeking an ethical, professional, and reliable Biology / Environmental Studies Tutor based in the Philippines to join our remote team. We support U.S.-based high school students through a team-based model, where each student is guided by a Head Counselor, Essay Editor, and Subject Tutors. As a tutor, you'll provide subject-specific support to help our students strengthen their academic foundations and prepare confidently for AP (Advanced Placement) coursework and exams — these are college-level classes that American high school students take to earn college credit.



What You'll Do:

- Subject-Specific Tutoring: Tutor Biology and Environmental Science at the AP and Honors levels (Honors = advanced high school courses). You should be comfortable with the AP Biology and AP Environmental Science ("APES") curricula, the format of their exams, and how the FRQs (Free-Response Questions — the written/essay portion of AP exams) are scored.

- Student-Centered Instruction: Use a Socratic teaching style — meaning you guide students to the answer through questions instead of lecturing at them. Explain tough concepts (e.g., cellular respiration, ecological succession, photosynthesis) in simple language, and figure out why a student is stuck (vocabulary gap, misread question, or missing background knowledge) before re-teaching.

- Lab & Exam Strategy: Coach students through experimental design, data interpretation, and AP-style "design-and-justify" FRQs (where students design an experiment and explain their reasoning), alongside multiple-choice strategy for AP Bio and APES.

- Team Collaboration: Work closely with the student's Head Counselor so your tutoring supports the student's bigger academic and college-admissions plan — not just the next test.

- Prompt, Prepared Communication: Reply to messages from students, parents, and the Telos team within 24 business hours. Prepare before every session, take clear session notes, track student progress, and raise any concerns early.



Who You Are:

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Biology, Environmental Science, Pre-Med, STEM Education, or a closely related scientific field is required. A Pre-Med, lab research, or graduate-level science background is a plus.

- Tutoring Experience: Documented one-on-one experience tutoring high school students in life sciences, ideally at the AP or Honors level. Experience tutoring SAT or ACT Science (the major U.S. college entrance exams) or other standardized science tests is a bonus.

- Warm & Approachable: You come across as the kind of person a teenager actually wants to keep working with — patient, encouraging, and never intimidating.

- U.S. High School Context: Familiar with how the U.S. high school system works — including AP exams, GPA (Grade Point Average — the standard U.S. academic average, usually on a 4.0 scale), transcripts, and how American teens approach college admissions — even while based in the Philippines.

- Cross-Cultural Communication: Communicate clearly and warmly with U.S. students and parents in fluent, natural-sounding English, and stay professional across time zones.

- Mission-Aligned: Excited about Telos's team-based, mentorship-oriented, "AI-Enhanced but Human-Centered" model — not looking for a generic tutoring side gig.

- Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working in a fully remote, AI-enhanced environment, including using tools like Claude, Gemini, or NotebookLM to help prepare lessons.



Schedule & Work Environment:

- Remote Setup: This role is structured as remote (Philippines-based).

- Flexible Hours: Work hours are flexible within reason, provided all deliverables are completed on time and client communication remains timely and professional.

- Availability: Must be available to tutor U.S.-based students during their after-school hours (3:00 PM to 10:00 PM Pacific Time) and on weekends. Note: this corresponds to early morning to mid-day Philippine Time the following day.



What We Offer:

- Pay: Hourly rate

- Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role.

title: STR Operations Coordinator (Airbnb / Hostaway)
description:
PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE POST. There are specific application instructions at the very bottom. Applicants who do not follow them will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US

We run full-service, hands-off management for short-term rental owners across the US. Guests get a warm, fast, five-star experience. Owners get their property run for them. We move fast and automate everything we can. You bring the judgment and follow-through; our software cannot.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

This is a coordination and operations role. You are NOT writing guest messages from scratch. Our system already drafts most guest replies. Your job on messaging is simply to review and approve the good ones and flag the rest for us. The core of your day is keeping turnovers, vendors, and calendars on track across our portfolio.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Schedule and confirm cleaners after every guest checkout. Chase until locked.

- Dispatch maintenance and handyman vendors, follow up, and track repair status and cost.

- Watch calendars across listings and flag any double-booking risk right away.

- Confirm each unit is guest-ready before check-in.

- Review pre-drafted guest replies: approve the clearly correct, routine ones; skip and escalate anything that needs judgment. When in doubt, you escalate. We reward escalating over guessing.

- Gather missing property facts from owners and draft clean entries for us to publish.



MUST-HAVES

- 1+ year in STR / vacation-rental operations or guest support.

- Hands-on with Airbnb, VRBO, and a channel manager (Hostaway strongly preferred).

- Warm, natural, native-level written English. Short and friendly, not stiff.

- Strong judgment on routine tasks vs. a problem that needs a human.

- Reliable, organized, and honest. If you cannot confirm a fact, you say so. You never make one up.

- Stable power and internet, with a backup, on a US-daytime shift.



HOURS AND PAY

- Around $900/month, roughly 25 hours per week plus on-call responsiveness during your shift (15-minute response, from your phone if needed).

- We pay the 13th-month bonus, offer flexible time off, and cover your equipment. We treat our people well, and the good ones grow with us.

- A short paid trial project comes before any ongoing offer. We pay you for it.



BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF: This role has an on-call element. If you like to clock in, clock out, and forget it, this is not for you. If you own outcomes and respond fast, it is a great fit.

title: Product Launch Specialist (E-commerce) — Start Part-Time, Grow to Full-Time
description:
ABOUT US

A Man & His Cave is an established Australian e-commerce retailer of premium "man cave" products — pool tables, bar fridges, saunas, ice baths, arcade machines and more. We've been going six years, we're growing fast, and we're building the systems to scale properly.



THE ROLE

We're looking for a product-obsessed launch specialist to own how new products go from idea to live and selling. This role is about product first — researching it, understanding it, getting it built to our exact spec and out the door — wrapped in the project-management discipline to make it all happen on time. 



To be clear: you will not be d
 what we launch. Our founder sets the product vision and briefs you on exactly what we want and why. Your job is to deeply understand that brief and drive it to reality — keeping our sourcing agent accountable, every launch on track, and every team across it. A launch isn't finished when the product lands; it's finished when Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and CX can all sell and support it. You are the quarterback. Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own product launches end to end — take the founder's product brief and run it all the way to live, executing the detail and the intent faithfully.

- Understand the product deeply — research categories and competitors, learn the specs and the "why", and bring back intelligence that sharpens each launch.

- Manage everything in Asana — clear stages, owners, deadlines and handoffs for every launch.

- Keep our China sourcing agent accountable — track every milestone (samples, POs, production, freight, landing dates) and flag slippage EARLY, before it becomes a missed launch.

- Chase handoffs proactively so nothing waits on someone who forgot about it.

-  Keep sourcing, sales and marketing aligned on the same launch dates and the same facts.

- Get the whole team across every new product — prepare and share a launch pack so Sales,

- Marketing, E-commerce and CX are fully briefed before a product goes
 key selling points for sales, angles and assets for marketing, correct listing details for e-commerce, and product knowledge and FAQs for customer service.

- Maintain a go/no-go checklist and a documented launch process every product runs through.

- Report launch status weekly.



How you'll work with our founder. 

Read this carefully. 

Our founder personally briefs each product — the exact specs, the details we like, what we want made and why it fits our brand. In your first weeks he will invest real time teaching you how we think about product so you understand our lines deeply. You bring the product understanding and the project-management discipline; he brings the vision and owns the final call. As you prove your judgment, you'll be trusted with more.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Obsessive attention to detail — and you can prove it. This is non-negotiable. Something in you should be physically unable to let a sloppy handoff or a wrong date go out the door. If detail is just a line on your résumé rather than how you're wired, this isn't your role.

- Proven end-to-end ownership of a detail-critical process that other people relied on — you held the standard, you didn't just tick off tasks someone else planned.

- A genuine eye for product — you can feel the difference between something that will sell and something that won't.

- Coachable, with backbone. Our founder will pour his standards into you early; you'll absorb them and make them your own, without needing to be told twice.

- 2+ years in e-commerce product, launches, or product-focused project management — NOT general admin.

- You flag a slipping deadline early — you never go quiet and hope.

- Confident with Asana (or similar); excellent written and spoken English (you'll deal directly with suppliers and our Australian team); 

- comfortable working alongside AI tools.



This role is NOT for you if: you need step-by-step instructions to stay on track; you've only ever executed plans other people made; you go quiet when something is slipping instead of raising it; or "attention to detail" is something you claim rather than something you can show us. We are hiring one excellent person, not filling a seat.



HOURS & SCHEDULE

- Starts at ~20 hours/week, growing to full-time (40 hours/week) as our launch volume increases. We want someone who wants that path.

- Australian business hours (we're in Sydney). You're only 2–3 hours behind us — no night shift.



PAY

- AUD $15 / hour (approximately USD $10 / hour).

- Part-time (20 hrs/week) ? AUD $1,300/month. 

- Full-time (40 hrs/week) ? AUD $2,600/month.

- Paid weekly or fortnightly, whichever you prefer.

Reports to: Ross, Head of Ops



HOW TO APPLY

- Start your application with the word CAVE so we know you read this whole post.

- In 3–4 sentences, describe one product launch or pipeline you personally ran end to end — what it was, how you kept it on track, and what nearly went wrong.

- Tell us about a product or category you know well and why it sells.

- List the project management tools you've used.

We read every application that starts with CAVE. We ignore the rest.
