title: Junior Property Manager (US-EST)
description:
About This Role

This is a career-level property management position, not a virtual assistant role.



Suites by VTJ is a property management company based in Raleigh, North Carolina. We manage a mixed portfolio of long-term residential, commercial, and short-term rental properties. Part of our tenant base communicates exclusively in Spanish, and we need a Junior Property Manager who can serve both English and Spanish-speaking tenants at the same professional standard.



If you have real property management experience, a proven remote work track record, and the discipline to run a portfolio without daily supervision, this role is built for you.



What You Will Own

Lease Operations: Review and finalize all lease agreements, renewals, addenda, and amendments before they go out for signature. 



Tenant Relationship Management: Handle all escalated tenant communications such as complaints, disputes, delinquency conversations, move-in and move-out coordination. Manage the full scope of tenant accounts without routing through the CEO. Respond to all tenant messages within the 2-hour standard during your shift. Knowledge in conversational Spanish is a plus.



Rent Collection and Follow-Through: Ensure all late accounts have a documented touchpoint by the 3rd of every month without exception. Send reminders, issue late notices, document every step, and hand clean records to the accounting team. Conduct payment plan conversations with professionalism and firmness. 



Maintenance Oversight and Vendor Management: Track every open maintenance ticket from report to confirmed resolution. Hold vendors accountable to their timelines. Verify insurance certificates and contract compliance. Update tenants proactively.



Compliance and Emergency Readiness: Keep all properties compliant with HOA rules, local policy, and vendor contract requirements. Maintain an up-to-date emergency contact and response protocol for each property so urgent after-hours situations have a clear first action.



Skills Required

Property Management Skills

- Lease administration: drafting, reviewing, and finalizing residential and commercial leases, addenda, and amendments

- Tenant communication and relationship management: English and Spanish (nice to have)

- Rent collection management: reminders, late notices, payment plans, and documentation

- Maintenance coordination: ticket tracking, vendor follow-up, insurance certificate verification

- Move-in and move-out coordination: inspections, key handoffs, deposit documentation

- Lease renewal management: proactive outreach, negotiation, and completion

- HOA compliance: routing notices, maintaining records, flagging violations

- Vacancy management: tour coordination, prospect communication, and conversion

- E-signature workflow management (DocuSign or equivalent)



Technical and Tool Skills

- Property Management Software: DoorLoop (preferred) or Buildium, AppFolio, Yardi, or equivalent proficiency required

- Google Workspace: Gmail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Google Calendar daily use

- Project Management: ClickUp or equivalent task tracking and workflow management

- Communication: Slack for internal messaging, Ooma or VoIP for tenant and vendor calls

- Time Tracking: Hubstaff used for remote accountability during shift hours, with screen capture enabled

- Video Meetings: Google Meet for team check-ins and candidate interviews

- Document Design: Utilize Canva for basic tenant communication materials when needed



Soft Skills

- A keen eye to detail: time-sensitive documents, dates, dollar amounts, and addenda  

- Remote self-management: ability to run a full workday without a manager present, with proactive communication discipline

- Independent judgment: makes decisions at the portfolio level and escalates only what genuinely requires CEO input

- Professional written and verbal English: tenant notices, lease correspondence, and vendor communication

- Professional written and verbal Spanish: nice to have for formal tenant correspondence, complaints, and collections calls

- De-escalation: calm, firm, and solutions-oriented with difficult or upset tenants in both languages

- Team direction: raises the output quality of a junior tea
mber through direct, specific, non-punishing feedback

- Prioritization under pressure: manages multiple open items across multiple properties simultaneously without dropping details

- Ownership mindset: closes every loop, documents every touchpoint, and surfaces problems before they become visible to leadership



You Are The Right Fit If:

- You have 2 or more years in property management, leasing, or real estate operations

- You have managed both residential and commercial properties

- You have worked fully remote before and can describe what your personal accountability system looks like

- You have directed or reviewed a junior tea
mber's work and corrected their output directly

- You write and speak Spanish at a professional level, great for formal correspondence

- Your home office is ready: 60 Mbps or faster, dual monitors, 16 GB+ RAM or Mac, dedicated headset, quiet private workspace



This Role Is Not For You If

- You need daily task lists to know what to prioritize

- You are not amenable to night-shift (US EST)

- You have only worked in-office or hybrid and have no fully-remote track record

- Difficult tenant conversations — in either language — make you uncomfortable

- Documentation is something you do when you remember, not as a first instinct



Home Office Requirements

Your setup is verified during the interview. Minimum standards:

 - Internet: 60 Mbps download or faster (screenshot required at application)

 - Monitors: Dual monitors

 - Computer: Modern multi-core CPU, 16 GB+ RAM, or Mac equivalent

 - Audio: Professional-grade headset — no laptop speakers or earbuds

 - Workspace: Private, quiet, and professional-looking on camera



Hiring Process

1. Application: Resume review, knockout questions + internet speed screenshot. Incomplete applications are not reviewed.

2. Pre-Assessment: 45–60 minute written assessment sent to passing applicants only. Tests scenario judgment, written communication, remote work discipline, and personality fit.

3. Google Meet Interview: 45-minute structured behavioral interview with the CEO. Includes a live workspace verification. Bilingual candidates will be checked on Spanish during the call.

4. Reference Checks — Finalists arrange calls between the CEO and two former direct supervisors. This step is mandatory. We tell every candidate this at the start.

5. Offer: Extended to one finalist on the day the decision is made.

title: Devops Systems Engineer
description:
ESTIMATED HOURS: On-call retainer / as-needed - NOT fixed hours, 5 hr/week (spikes during i
)



PAYMENT STRUCTURE (IMPORTANT -READ CAREFULLY):

- 50% paid in ETH (Ethereum), bi-weekly

- 50% paid in GMI token, vesting linearly over 18 months

- This is an aligned, skin-in-the-game structure

- If you want pure cash only, this role is NOT for you

- If you believe in Web3 and want long-term upside, keep reading



RESPONSE SLA: You must acknowledge any request or alert within 24 hours. Every time. This is the #1 requirement.





ABOUT US

Our team at Energi Core runs production blockchain infrastructure on AWS -EKS (Kubernetes), RDS databases, EC2 instances, RPC nodes, and indexers, across both mainnet and testnet environments. Our senior DevOps is excellent but overloaded. We need a blockchain-native engineer on standby to handle routine operations, catch problems early, and keep everything healthy.



We are past our build phase. We are not hiring someone to architect or refactor. We are hiring someone to WATCH, MAINTAIN, and FLAG.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Monitor RPC node health: sync status, peer count, block lag, reorg frequency

- Monitor indexer health: subgraph lag, indexing errors, data drift

- Watch RDS database pressure: CPU, connections, storage

- Monitor EKS pods, nodes, and load balancers across mainnet and testnet

- Triage alerts with blockchain-aware judgment (mainnet first)

- Run weekly cleanup: unattached EBS volumes, orphaned IPs, old snapshots, stale container images, old CloudWatch logs

- Enforce tagging, access control, and documentation standards

- Produce weekly and monthly infrastructure health reports

- Handle user onboarding and offboarding across GitLab, VPN, and AWS SSO

- Escalate production-critical or architectural issues to Senior DevOps with chain-aware context





WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO

- No mainnet deploys, rollbacks, or architecture changes

- No validator key or signer operations

- No VPC, networking, or security group changes

- No IAM policy design

- No database migrations or schema changes

- No Terraform or Infrastructure-as-Code changes

- No mainnet i
 response (you escalate immediately)

- Nothing that touches wallets, trading paths, or revenue systems



HARD REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

We have learned the hard way that generic DevOps does not work for blockchain. If you do not have ALL of the following, please do not apply:



1. Minimum 2 years of hands-on production blockchain infrastructure experience at a crypto or Web3 company (not a hobby, not a bootcamp, not a side project)



2. Proven experience operating full nodes or RPC nodes in production -Geth, Erigon, Nethermind, Reth, or equivalent



3. Proven experience running indexers or subgraphs in production -The Graph, Subsquid, Ponder, or custom-built



4. Hands-on Kubernetes / EKS experience running stateful chain workloads



5. Strong AWS fluency -EC2, EBS, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, Cost Explorer (console AND CLI)



6. kubectl fluency -get pods, describe, logs, top, delete, exec



7. Dashboard literacy -CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, or Prometheus



8. Discipline to respond within 24 hours, every single time, without fail



9. Genuine comfort being paid 50% ETH and 50% GMI vested over 18 months





NICE TO HAVE (BONUS)

- Experience with EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, BSC, Arbitrum, Base, etc.)

- Validator operations or staking infrastructure exposure

- MEV infrastructure or block-building familiarity

- Helm, Karpenter, or Terraform (read-only is fine)

- Prior on-call rotations on blockchain infrastructure

title: Amazon Account Specialist / Brand Manager - Full Time, Long Term, Well Paying
description:
About the Role



We are a USA based business selling our own custom branded private label products on Amazon USA. We are expanding our catalog and need support with our growth. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager to take ownership of our catalog management, listing optimization, product launch execution, and daily Amazon operations.



This role requires hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. You will work closely with a small team to drive product growth, improve listing performance, monitor account health, and support new product development from research through post-launch optimization.



We are looking for someone who can work independently, solve problems proactively, and provide clear, data-driven recommendations while maintaining a high level of accuracy and organization.



Key Responsibilities



Amazon Listing & Catalog Management

- Create, optimize, and maintain Amazon listings, including titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, and variation structures.

- Conduct keyword research and SEO optimization using keyword tools

- Monitor listing health, suppressions, stranded inventory, catalog errors, and compliance issues.

- Manage flat file uploads, variation troubleshooting, browse node updates, and catalog maintenance.



Product Launch & Growth

- Coordinate new product launches, listing readiness, inventory planning, and launch execution.

- Monitor post-launch performance including sales, conversion rates, keyword rankings, reviews, inventory levels, and competitor activity.

- Identify opportunities to improve traffic, conversions, profitability, and sales performance.



Seller Central Operations

- Manage daily Amazon Seller Central activities and account operations.

- Monitor account health, customer feedback, returns, compliance issues, and operational risks.

- Create and manage Amazon support cases, dispute tickets, and issue resolution processes.

- Ensure products remain compliant with Amazon policies and marketplace requirements.



Reporting & Performance Analysis

-Track key performance metrics including sessions, conversion rate, sales, keyword rankings, profitability, inventory levels, and BSR.

-Prepare regular reports with actionable recommendations, priorities, risks, and next steps.

-Maintain organized documentation, trackers, Google Sheets, and operational records.



Product Research & Development Support

-Conduct product, market, competitor, and review analysis to identify product opportunities and improvement ideas.

-Provide clear recommendations supported by research and business reasoning.



Qualifications

-2+ years of hands-on Amazon Private Label experience.

-Strong experience with Amazon Seller Central and related Amazon 3rd Party Tools

-Proven experience managing listings, catalog operations, product launches, and account health.

-Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO, keyword research, competitor analysis, and conversion optimization.

-Experience with variation creation, suppression recovery, flat files, compliance cases, and catalog troubleshooting.

-Understanding of Amazon FBA operations, inventory planning, and replenishment management.

-Comfortable using AI tools

-Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

-Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets.

-Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

-Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and provide clear updates and recommendations.

-Comfortable using SOPs while exercising sound business judgment and critical thinking.



Preferred Attributes

-Detail-oriented and highly organized.

-Proactive and solution-focused.

-Data-driven decision maker.

-Comfortable working in a growing e-commerce environment.

-Collaborative team player with strong ownership mentality.



What Success Looks Like

-Healthy and optimized Amazon catalog with minimal downtime.

-Successful product launches executed on schedule.

-Continuous improvements in keyword rankings, conversion rates, and sales performance.

-Strong account health and compliance management.

-Clear communication, reporting, and execution across all Amazon operations.

 

What the Company Offers

100% Remote

Competitive pay, incentives, 13th month, bonuses

Career growth & long-term stability

Learning & Development Opportunities



Technical Requirements

- Reliable PC/Laptop

- High-Speed Internet Connection (with Backup Solution is a plus)

- Quiet, Dedicated Workspace for Professional Remote Work



Application Instructions

If this sounds like you, we want to hear from you! Please answer the questions on this google form to apply:







We look forward to your application.

title: Client Activation & Tech Onboarding Manager - $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400/month)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Statistics Tutor
description:
Job Title: Academic Tutor (AP Statistics)

Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Type: Part-Time

Reports To: Director of Academic Programs



About the Role:

Telos Prep is seeking an ethical, professional, and reliable AP Statistics Tutor based in the Philippines to join our remote team. We support U.S.-based high school students through a team-based model, where each student is guided by a Head Counselor, Essay Editor, and Subject Tutors. As a tutor, you'll provide subject-specific support to help our students strengthen their academic foundations and prepare confidently for AP (Advanced Placement) Statistics coursework and the AP exam — these are college-level classes that American high school students take to earn college credit.



What You'll Do:

- Subject-Specific Tutoring: Tutor Statistics at the AP and Honors levels (Honors = advanced high school courses), with strong working knowledge of the AP Statistics course framework — sampling, probability, and inference — and the exam format (multiple-choice plus 6 FRQs, or Free-Response Questions — the written/problem-solving portion of AP exams — including the longer "investigative task").

- Student-Centered Instruction: Use a Socratic teaching style — meaning you guide students to the answer through questions instead of lecturing at them. Explain tough concepts (e.g., sampling distributions, p-values, conditions for inference) in simple language.

- FRQ Coaching: Teach students how to set up hypotheses, check conditions, run the right procedures, and write conclusions in context, the way the AP rubric expects.

- Diagnose Before Re-Teaching: When a student loses points, figure out why — whether it's a conceptual gap, a computational mistake, or unclear written communication — before re-teaching.

- Team Collaboration: Work closely with the student's Head Counselor so your tutoring supports the student's bigger academic and college-admissions plan — not just the next test.

- Prompt, Prepared Communication: Reply to messages from students, parents, and the Telos team within 24 business hours. Prepare before every session, take clear session notes, track student progress, and raise any concerns early.



Who You Are:

- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, STEM Education, or a closely related field is required. Graduate work in statistics, data science, economics, or quantitative research is a plus.

- Tutoring Experience: Documented one-on-one experience tutoring high school students in advanced math, ideally at the AP Statistics level. Experience tutoring SAT/ACT math (the major U.S. college entrance exams), Pre-Calculus, or Calculus is a bonus.

- Tooling Fluency: Comfortable using a TI-83/84 graphing calculator (the standard calculator allowed on the AP Stats exam) and Desmos (a free online graphing/statistics tool widely used by U.S. students). Light comfort with spreadsheets, Python, or R for demonstrating concepts is a plus.

- Warm & Approachable: You come across as the kind of person a teenager actually wants to keep working with — patient, encouraging, and never intimidating.

- U.S. High School Context: Familiar with how the U.S. high school system works — including AP exams, GPA (Grade Point Average — the standard U.S. academic average, usually on a 4.0 scale), transcripts, and how American teens approach college admissions — even while based in the Philippines.

- Cross-Cultural Communication: Communicate clearly and warmly with U.S. students and parents in fluent, natural-sounding English, and stay professional across time zones.

- Mission-Aligned: Excited about Telos's team-based, mentorship-oriented, "AI-Enhanced but Human-Centered" model — not looking for a generic tutoring side gig.

- Tech-Savvy: Comfortable working in a fully remote, AI-enhanced environment, including using tools like Claude, Gemini, or NotebookLM to help prepare lessons.



Schedule & Work Environment:

- Remote Setup: This role is structured as remote (Philippines-based).

- Flexible Hours: Work hours are flexible within reason, provided all deliverables are completed on time and client communication remains timely and professional.

- Availability: Must be available to tutor U.S.-based students during their after-school hours (3:00 PM to 10:00 PM Pacific Time) and on weekends. Note: this corresponds to early morning to mid-day Philippine Time the following day.



What We Offer:

- Pay: Hourly rate

- Resources: Telos will provide the necessary software subscriptions and tools required for the role.

title: LinkedIn Content Creator & Platform Manager
description:
Excel Dictionary | Part-Time | Fully Remote



About the Role



We have a LinkedIn following of over 660,000 people — and we know it's an underleveraged asset. Right now, our LinkedIn presence is mostly a repost of video content from our other platforms a few times a week. That's not enough. We want LinkedIn to feel like a person, not a feed of recycled clips.



We're looking for a LinkedIn Content Creator & Platform Manager to take ownership of the page, build a real personality-driven presence, and grow us into a top voice on the platform — with an eye toward eventually funneling that audience into our products.



This is a part-time, fully remote role, ideal for someone who already thinks in LinkedIn-native content and wants real creative ownership over a large, established audience.



What You'll Do





Own the content calendar. Plan and create a content mix that goes beyond repurposed video — think personality posts, photos, behind-the-scenes 
nts, hot takes, and native LinkedIn formats (text posts, carousels, polls, etc.)

Build a voice. Help shape and maintain a consistent, authentic personality for the brand on LinkedIn — one that feels human, not corporate.

Manage community engagement. Respond to comments, DMs, and mentions in a timely, on-brand way. Actively engage with other accounts to build visibility and relationships.

Repurpose smartly. Continue adapting video content from our other platforms, but reframe it specifically for how LinkedIn audiences consume content.

Track what works. Monitor performance, follower growth, and engagement trends; use that data to refine the content strategy over time.

Drive funnel thinking. Identify natural, non-salesy ways to guide engaged followers toward our products and offerings.

Report and collaborate. Check in regularly with leadership on strategy, performance, and upcoming content plans.





What We're Looking For





Proven experience growing or managing a LinkedIn page — personal brand, company page, or agency experience all count.

A strong sense of LinkedIn-native content: you know the difference between a post that gets scrolled past and one that gets saved and shared.

Excellent writing skills — able to capture a brand voice and make it sound like a person, not a press release.

Comfortable with light photo/video editing and repurposing existing footage/photos into platform-specific content.

Self-directed and organized — you can own a content calendar and a community without needing heavy oversight.

Bonus: experience turning organic social engagement into product or business results.





Why This Role

A real audience, not a cold start. You're inheriting 660K+ followers and shaping how they experience the brand going forward.

Creative ownership. This isn't "post what marketing sends you" — you'll have real input into voice, format, and strategy.

Flexibility. Part-time and fully remote, work on a schedule that fits your life.

title: Senior SaaS Performance Marketer – Meta Ads, Customer Acquisition and Growth
description:
We are hiring an exceptional performance marketer to help grow a SaaS company.



This is not a role for someone who simply knows how to launch
 campaigns, choose audiences, and create reports.



We need someone who understands the complete customer-acquisition process:



• Identifying the right market and customer

• Creating strong offers and advertising angles

• Developing high-converting ad creatives

• Managing and optimizing Meta advertising campaigns

• Improving landing pages and signup funnels

• Setting up accurate tracking and attribution

• Turning traffic into paying customers

• Reducing customer acquisition cost

• Scaling campaigns without destroying profitability



Your goal will not be to generate clicks, impressions, engagement, or cheap leads.



Your goal will be to generate paying customers profitably.



About the Role



You will be responsible for helping us build and operate a complete customer-acquisition system for a SaaS product.



The product is designed for businesses, so experience with B2B SaaS, software, fintech, payment products, accounting products, business services, or other complex offers is highly preferred.



You must understand that SaaS advertising is different from selling a simple ecommerce product. A customer may click an ad, visit the website, create an account, complete onboarding, activate a feature, and only later become a paying customer.



You must know how to measure and improve every step of that process.



Responsibilities



• Develop the overall paid advertising and customer-acquisition strategy

• Build, manage, and optimize Meta advertising campaigns

• Understand Meta’s current advertising system, including Andromeda, campaign structure, creative diversity, signal quality, broad targeting, conversion data, and machine-learning optimization

• Research customers, competitors, pain points, objections, and buying motivations

• Develop advertising angles, hooks, offers, scripts, and creative briefs

• Work with designers and video editors to produce effective ads

• Create a structured creative-testing system

• Analyze which ads are attracting qualified customers instead of low-quality traffic

• Improve landing pages, signup pages, onboarding flows, and conversion rates

• Review website recordings, analytics, and funnel data to identify where customers are dropping off

• Set up and verify Meta Pixel, Conversions API, UTMs, events, and attribution

• Track customer acquisition cost, conversion rate, trial-to-paid conversion, revenue, payback period, and return on advertising spend

• Diagnose campaigns that are not working and explain exactly why

• Create weekly reports that clearly explain what happened, what was learned, and what will be tested next

• Scale successful campaigns while protecting profitability

• Coordinate with the founder, developers, designers, and other tea
mbers



Required Experience



You must have meaningful hands-on experience generating sales or paying customers through paid advertising.



We strongly prefer candidates who have:



• Managed Meta advertising campaigns with substantial real advertising spend

• Generated measurable revenue, subscriptions, booked calls, qualified customers, or other valuable business results

• Worked with SaaS companies, software products, B2B offers, fintech, professional services, or complicated sales funnels

• Built campaigns from the beginning instead of only maintaining campaigns created by someone else

• Experience with cold traffic, retargeting, creative testing, landing-page testing, and conversion optimization

• Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, attribution, analytics, and tracking

• Experience analyzing customer acquisition cost rather than only cost per click or cost per lead

• Experience working with designers, copywriters, video editors, and developers

• The ability to explain advertising strategy clearly without hiding behind jargon



You must understand metrics including:



• Customer acquisition cost

• Cost per qualified lead

• Cost per trial or signup

• Trial-to-paid conversion rate

• Landing-page conversion rate

• Click-through rate

• Cost per thousand impressions

• Lifetime value

• Payback period

• Churn and retention

• Return on advertising spend

• Incremental revenue and attribution



Who Should Not Apply



Do not apply if:



• Your only experience is boosting posts

• You have only managed tiny campaigns with no measurable business results

• You only know how to create campaigns but cannot improve the offer, ads, landing page, or funnel

• You measure success only using clicks, engagement, or cheap leads

• You depend entirely on interest targeting or “secret audiences”

• You cannot explain how Meta’s machine-learning system uses conversion signals and creative data

• You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to previous campaigns

• You send generic applications to every job

• You plan to outsource this position to someone else

• You guarantee unrealistic results before understanding the product, economics, tracking, and funnel



Proof Required



Do not simply tell us that you are an expert.



You must provide evidence.



Your application must include the following:



1. A Loom Video



Record a five-to-ten-minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining one campaign you personally managed.



Whenever possible, walk us through a real advertising account or reporting dashboard. You may blur confidential information, client names, account numbers, and other sensitive details.



Explain:



• What the company sold

• Who the target customer was

• The monthly advertising budget

• The campaign objective

• The funnel used

• The offer and advertising angles

• The creatives that performed best

• The number of customers, sales, subscriptions, or qualified opportunities generated

• The customer acquisition cost

• The approximate revenue generated

• The length of time you managed the campaign

• What was working before you became involved

• What you personally changed

• What happened after your changes

• How you verified that Meta contributed to the results



Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.



2. One Detailed Case Study



Provide one detailed example of a campaign you personally helped grow.



Include:



• Advertising spend

• Number of conversions

• Revenue or pipeline generated

• Customer acquisition cost

• Conversion rate

• Return on advertising spend, when applicable

• Your exact responsibilities

• The biggest problem you discovered

• The changes you made

• The final result



Screenshots without explanations are not enough.



3. Proof of Your Role



Clearly explain which parts of the campaign you personally handled.



For example:



• Campaign strategy

• Media buying

• Copywriting

• Creative strategy

• Video scripting

• Landing-page strategy

• Tracking

• Reporting

• Conversion optimization



Do not take credit for an entire campaign if you only handled one small part of it.



4. References



Provide the name and contact information of at least one previous employer or client who can verify your work.



Application Questions



Answer every question carefully.



1. What is the largest monthly Meta advertising budget you have personally managed?



2. What is the best customer-acquisition result you have produced? Include the spend, number of customers, revenue, customer acquisition cost, and time period.



3. Describe a campaign that failed. Why did it fail, and what did you learn?



4. How would you determine whether an advertising problem is caused by the campaign, creative, offer, landing page, tracking, onboarding, pricing, or product?



5. A campaign has an 18% click-through rate but almost no paying customers. What would you investigate first?



6. How do you d
 when an ad should be turned off?



7. How do you test creative angles without changing too many variables at once?



8. How has Meta’s advertising system changed, and how has that affected your approach to targeting, campaign structure, creative testing, and conversion signals?



9. How would you advertise a new B2B SaaS product with limited conversion data?



10. Which metrics would you review every day, every week, and every month?



11. How would you measure whether customers acquired through Meta are actually valuable customers?



12. What information would you need from us before recommending an advertising budget?



13. What would your first 30 days working with us look like?



14. What tools do you use for analytics, reporting, creative research, attribution, and landing-page optimization?



15. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time, long-term position?



How to Apply



Use the subject line:



I Generate Paying Customers – [Your Name]



Begin your application with this sentence:



A high click-through rate is useless when the traffic does not become profitable customers.



Then include:



• Your Loom video

• Your detailed case study

• Your resume

• Your portfolio

title: Remote Solar and Battery Sales Consultant - Australian Company
description:
About Us

Unplugged Energy is a dynamic and growing solar energy company based in Perth, Western Australia. We are passionate about helping homeowners switch to clean, renewable energy, saving them money and contributing to a greener planet. As demand for solar and batteries surges in Western Australia, we are expanding our sales team and looking for a motivated professional to join us.



The Opportunity

This is your chance to build a lucrative career in one of Australia's fastest-growing industries from the comfort of your home. We are seeking a results-driven and passionate Remote Solar & Battery Sales Consultant to join our high-performing team.

You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, converting warm, inbound leads into happy Unplugged Energy customers. This is not a lead generation role; you will be provided with qualified leads, allowing you to focus on what you do best: building rapport and closing sales. Full training on our products, systems, and the Australian solar and battery market will be provided.



What You'll Be Doing

You will be responsible for managing the entire sales process, including:

-Managing the sales@
 inbox and responding to all new customer enquiries promptly.

-Qualifying inbound leads to understand customer needs and project suitability.

-Engaging with potential customers via phone (RingCentral) and
. Strong and confident phone communication is essential for building rapport and closing deals.

-Educating clients on the financial and environmental benefits of our solar and battery solutions.

-Preparing customised, professional proposals using our Open Solar software.

-Diligently managing your sales pipeline and recording all customer interactions in our Zoho CRM system.

-Working to achieve and exceed sales targets.

-Building and maintaining long-term relationships with new and existing clients.



What We're Looking For (About You)

-A True Closer: You are a professional and dedicated individual with a tenacity for results. You aren't afraid to ask for the sale and have a proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets without being pushy, confident yet consultative.

-Exceptional Communicator: You must have proficient English communication skills, both written and verbal, with a clear and easily understood speaking voice and you have experience selling to Australian or Western customers and can build trust and rapport quickly over the phone.

-Sales Experience: You have a proven track record in a full-cycle sales role, ideally in solar, renewable energy, or another high-ticket industry. You can share specific examples of sales you’ve closed, especially where the customer was hesitant at first.

-Maths & Product Knowledge: You’re confident working with numbers to calculate bills, savings, and payback periods on the spot. You can learn and recall product details for multiple brands of solar panels, inverters, and batteries.

-Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable on a computer, confident managing multiple tabs, and quick to learn new software. We will train you on Zoho CRM and OpenSolar, but you must already be comfortable navigating web-based platforms and entering data accurately.

-Attitude: You are open-minded, flexible, hard-working, and bring a positive attitude to the team. You are a self-motivated high achiever who can work independently.

-Eager to Learn: You have a genuine passion for renewable energy and a drive to stay up-to-date on industry trends and products.

-Mindset & Work Ethic: You’re self-motivated, highly organised, and able to manage your own pipeline without constant oversight. You consistently follow through on tasks, keep your CRM clean, and deliver excellent service before, during, and after the sale.



Why You'll Love Working With Us

-100% Remote: Enjoy the stability of a full-time position from your home office.

-Excellent Remuneration: We offer a competitive base salary plus uncapped commissions. Your success determines your income.

-Warm, Qualified Leads: We generate our own leads. You will be provided with a steady stream of customers who are already interested in solar and batteries – no cold calling!

-A Product That Sells Itself: WA gets more sun than any other state in Australia, meaning our customers produce more power and save more money. With government incentives taking thousands off the cost and the ability to sell excess power back to the grid, solar is an easy decision for customers.

-Comprehensive Training & Support: We provide comprehensive training and ongoing mentorship to ensure your success.

-You will have full sales, admin, and technical support from our Perth-based team.

-Opportunity for Growth: Gain valuable skills and experience in a high-growth industry by working with a supportive and successful team.



How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional looking for a stable, long-term remote role, we would love to hear from you.



To apply, please send the following:

-A short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and highlighting your sales experience.

-Your updated resume and a personality profile if you have one

-A short paragraph answering the following question: "Describe your process for taking a new, warm lead from initial contact to a closed sale."

-Your expected monthly rate for the base salary component (in PHP or AUD).

-Your availability (earliest possible start date).



(Applications that do not include all of the above items will not be considered, as it helps us see who has read the full post and can follow instructions.)



We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Financial Analyst with Audit experience - fixed-term contract (6 months)
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.



We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.



By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.



And we’re just getting started.



As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. We offer a fixed-term contract (6 months). You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.



You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.



This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Prepare monthly and ad hoc financial reports, including P&L, gross profit, EBITDA, and cash flow analysis. Lead month-end and year-end closing processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of financial data. Deliver clear variance analysis, trend insights, and key KPIs such as LTV/CAC and other commercial metrics to support business decision-making.

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Supporting the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance

-Strong understanding of key financial metrics: EBITDA, gross profit, cash flow, LTV-CAC



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting and auditing

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?

This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive salary

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



Please send your resume with your cover letter when sending your application.

title: Social Media Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | Base + Commission | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time (40 hrs/week)



**Salary:** Monthly base retainer + performance commission on closed sales (details discussed at interview)



**ABOUT US**



We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 95,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 200 to 300 outbound DMs per day across our platforms (TikTok is the top priority, then Instagram, then
, then YouTube)

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- A guaranteed monthly base retainer, paid regardless of performance, so you always have a stable floor

- Plus performance commission on every booked call that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report every week, so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side

- Exact figures are shared at the interview stage



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: approximately 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Mountain Time, Monday to Friday. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role.

- Experience as an appointment setter, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche is a big plus)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with TikTok, Instagram, and
 
 interfaces

- Calendly experience is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches you have worked in

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I needed to hear this" on one of our videos about why undereating stalls fat loss. Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.



---



One honest heads-up: on OnlineJobs.ph, listings without any salary figure get noticeably fewer applicants, since experienced setters filter by pay. The "well above typical setter rates" and "premium pays triple entry" lines are there to compensate for that, but if application volume comes in thin after a week, adding just a total earnings range (without revealing the base/commission split) is the usual fix.

title: AEO / AI Search Visibility Specialist for B2B SaaS Client — Part-Time, 90-Day Retainer, Likely Ongoing
description:
I run a growth agency and I'm hiring an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO / AI visibility) specialist to deliver a defined 90-day program for a B2B SaaS client in the insurance technology space. The goal: when the client's buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, or Copilot who solves their problem, the client's brand appears in the answer. Today their competitors show up and they don't.



Important: you will NOT be writing most of the content or making website changes yourself. The client has an in-house content writer and web developer who execute. Your job is the strategy, the audits, the briefs, the specs, and the measurement. You work directly with me (agency owner); I own the client relationship. You never contact the client directly.



EXACT SCOPE OF WORK



Phase 1 (first 2 weeks): Measure and Diagnose



1. Build a structured panel of 40-60 buyer prompts across four categories: category/discovery questions, problem questions, competitor comparison questions, and brand validation questions. Sourced from buyer language I provide (sales call notes, CRM context), plus your own research.

2. Run a baseline audit: test the full panel across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and Copilot, multiple runs per prompt to account for answer variability. Record brand presence, competitor presence, position, sentiment, and every source the AI cites.

3. Deliver a baseline visibility scorecard: where the client appears, where competitors own the answer, share of voice by category.

4. Source-gap analysis: for every prompt where competitors win, identify which third-party domains the AI engines cited. Deliver a ranked target list of the sources we need to get the client into.

5. Technical AEO audit of the client's recently rebuilt website: AI crawler access (robots.txt against GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, etc.), rendering check (is content visible without JavaScript execution), schema presence, sitemap, llms.txt, and brand/entity consistency across web properties. Deliver as a pass/fail list with implementation-ready fix specs for the client's developer.



Phase 2 (weeks 2-12): Act



6. Content mapping: the client has a 30-part video series with full scripts. Map each script against the prompt panel and produce a prioritized page plan.

7. Page briefs (2-3 per week): for each priority page, deliver a brief the client's content writer can draft from without back-and-forth: target question as H1, answer-first structure (direct answer in the first 40-60 words), required statistics with named sources, quotable expert statement, FAQ block, internal links.

8. Review each drafted page for AEO fitness before publish.

9. Schema specs: implementation-ready markup specs (Organization, FAQPage, Article + Person, VideoObject, SoftwareApplication) the client's developer can implement directly. Verify implementation after publish.

10. YouTube optimization for the existing 30-part series: question-phrased titles, cleaned transcripts, answer-first descriptions linking to matching site pages, series playlist structure.

11. Off-site citation coordination driven by the source-gap list: review platform profiles, directory listings, structuring press releases and contributed articles for citability, and an indexable podcast transcript page.



Ongoing: Prove



12. Re-run the full prompt panel every two weeks (tool or documented manual protocol, your choice, I'll approve the method).

13. Monthly report I present to the client: visibility movement vs baseline by question category, share of voice vs named competitors, citations won, and recommended next actions.



REQUIREMENTS



- Demonstrated AEO/GEO work with at least one before/after example of measurably improving a brand's presence in AI-generated answers (be ready to show proof: screenshots, tracking reports)

- Working knowledge of how LLMs select and cite sources (answer-first content, entity signals, schema, third-party authority)

- Hands-on schema markup experience: you write specs a developer implements without questions

- Solid traditional SEO foundation

- Able to write clear content briefs for a non-specialist writer

- Fluent written English, organized, deadline-reliable, comfortable working async

- NDA required before the client's name is shared



NICE TO HAVE



- B2B SaaS experience, ideally insurance, fintech, or another regulated vertical

- YouTube SEO experience

- Familiarity with AI visibility tracking tools (Otterly, LLMrefs, Peec, or a manual methodology you can show)

- LinkedIn Sales Navigator / outbound automation experience (separate workstream, a plus, not required)



ENGAGEMENT



- Part-time, approximately 10-15 hours/week, heavier in the first 3 weeks

- 90-day initial engagement with strong likelihood of ongoing monthly work

- Start within days of hire; Phase 1 deliverables (prompt panel, baseline scorecard, technical audit, source-gap list) due within the first 10 days



SCREENING QUESTIONS (answer all in your application)



1. Describe one engagement where you measurably improved a brand's visibility in AI answers. Starting point, what you did, what changed. Include proof if you can.

2. Walk me through, step by step, how you'd build a buyer-prompt panel for a niche B2B vertical you've never worked in.

3. How do you track AI citation presence over time? Name your tools or manual method. A sample or redacted report puts you at the top of the list.

Applications that don't answer the screening questions will not be considered. Generic applications will not be considered.

 outbound, LinkedIn outbound, content creation, etc.) is also considered for this reason.

title: Senior Meta Ads Buyer + Performance Creative Strategist for DTC Supplement Brand
description:
Cloud9 Supplements is hiring a Senior Meta Ads Buyer + Performance Creative Strategist to help scale our DTC supplement brand from approximately $4M/year to $1M+/month.



This is not a basic
 ads management role.



We need someone who understands:



* Meta ads for DTC ecommerce

* direct-response creative strategy

* static ad creation

* UGC/video briefing

* landing page and funnel strategy

* supplement buyer psychology

* creative testing

* scaling winners

* killing losers fast

* reading real performance data



Our main products include:



Daily Restore — daily liver and recovery support for health-conscious people who drink socially, care about liver health, and want to support their body after alcohol, stress, processed food, and modern metabolic burden.



Crave Away — support for alcohol cravings and urge control, especially for people who want the second drink or craving loop to feel less automatic.



We run Meta ads, Shopify funnels, advertorials, VSLs, UGC, static ads, and direct-response landing pages.



You will work directly with the founder.



Your Role



You will help own the full creative-performance loop:



Research ? angle strategy ? ad concepts ? static creative ? video briefs ? landing page direction ? launch ? analysis ? iteration



You should be able to look at winning ads, customer reviews, competitor ads, landing pages, and Meta data, then turn that into new concepts that can actually spend and convert.



Responsibilities



Meta Ads Buying



* Build and manage Meta campaigns for DTC supplements

* Launch and test new creative concepts efficiently

* Manage CBO and ABO campaigns

* Understand broad targeting, creative testing, scaling, and fatigue

* Monitor CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CVR, AOV, spend, frequency, and contribution

* Make daily decisions on what to kill, keep, duplicate, scale, or relaunch

* Create daily and weekly performance summaries



Creative Strategy



* Research competitor ads, winning supplement angles, Reddit threads, reviews, YouTube, TikTok, and Meta Ad Library

* Develop new ad angles and hooks

* Build creative pods around specific avatars and beliefs

* Write static ad concepts and copy

* Create strong cold-traffic static ads using Canva/Figma/Photoshop

* Brief video editors for UGC, AI UGC, motion statics, and VSL-style ads

* Identify why ads are winning or failing



Funnel / Landing Page Strategy



* Match ads to the correct landing page

* Help create advertorial/listicle/page concepts

* Spot landing page friction

* Recommend page tests based on creative angle and buyer intent

* Understand offer fit, subscription friction, AOV, and checkout flow



Required Experience



Please only apply if you have real experience with most of the following:



* 2+ years managing Meta ads for ecommerce

* DTC supplement, health, beauty, wellness, fitness, or similar experience

* Experience spending at least $1000-$2,000/day on Meta

* Experience with Shopify brands

* Strong understanding of creative testing

* Ability to make strong static ads yourself

* Ability to analyze ad performance beyond surface-level CTR

* Understanding of direct-response hooks, mechanisms, offers, and funnels

* Good written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Comfortable using AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Canva AI, etc.



You Are NOT A Fit If



Do not apply if:



* You only know boosted posts

* You are mainly a social media manager

* You only follow client instructions and do not think strategically

* You cannot create static ads yourself

* You judge ads mainly by CTR

* You do not understand landing pages

* You have never worked with ecommerce

* You need step-by-step instructions for every task

* You are uncomfortable being judged by performance



What Great Looks Like



A great person in this role can:



* Study 50 ads and find the pattern underneath the winners

* Turn one insight into 5–10 ad concepts

* Build simple but strong static ads for cold traffic

* Understand when high CTR is misleading

* Know when an ad is a false positive

* Know when Meta attribution is lying

* Connect creative angle to landing page intent

* Launch tests without overcomplicating the account

* Communicate clearly and directly

* Move fast without being sloppy



Weekly Output Expectations



Once trained, you should be able to help produce:



* 5–10 new angle ideas per week

* 10–20 new ad concepts/variations per week

* 5–10 strong static ads per week

* 2–5 video/UGC briefs per week

* 1–2 landing page or advertorial concepts per month

* Daily media buying notes

* Weekly creative performance review



Quality matters more than raw volume.



We do not want random ads. We want strategic, well-researched, direct-response ads.



Tools You Should Know



Helpful tools:



* Meta Ads Manager

* Shopify

* Canva

* Figma or Photoshop

* Google Sheets

* Meta Ad Library

* Foreplay, MagicBrief, or similar swipe tools

* ChatGPT / Claude / AI tools for creative and landers

* Triple Whale, Northbeam, GA4, or similar attribution tools



You do not need to know every tool, but you must be fast at learning.



Compensation



Base salary:



$1,500–$2,500/month+ USD, depending on experience.



Performance bonus opportunities:



* Bonus for validated winning ad concepts

* Bonus for ads that scale profitably

* Bonus for helping improve account performance

* Long-term growth opportunity as the brand scales



We want someone long-term who can grow with the company.



Application Instructions



To apply, reply with the word:



CLOUD9



at the top of your application.



Then answer these questions:



1. What DTC ecommerce brands have you personally managed Meta ads for?

2. Have you worked with supplements, health, wellness, beauty, fitness, or similar products?

3. What was the highest monthly ad spend you personally managed?

4. What was your best-performing campaign and why did it work?

5. What is one campaign that failed, and what did you learn?

6. Explain your creative testing process.

7. How do you d
 whether to kill or scale an ad?

8. Can you make static ads yourself? Please include 3–5 examples.

9. Please include screenshots of Meta Ads Manager results where possible. You may blur private info.

10. Please include any landing pages, advertorials, or funnel pages you helped with.

11. What AI tools do you use in your workflow?

12. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

13. Are you available full-time?

14. Can you overlap 2–3 hours per day with U.S. Pacific Time?



Applications that do not follow instructions will be ignored.



Paid Test



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid test.



The test will include:



* Reviewing Cloud9 ads and landing pages

* Creating new ad angles

* Writing ad concepts

* Making one static ad

* Recommending a campaign testing structure



We pay for strong test submissions.

title: Lead Manager / Cold Caller (Land Investing)
description:
Summary

We are a growing US land investment company, and our marketing is generating more seller leads than our current team can handle. We're looking for a high-energy Outbound Lead Manager to work the phones — this is a lead generation and outbound sales role first, not a closing role. You'll be making 150+ calls per day minimum, qualifying land sellers, and pushing qualified leads to our closer.



This role is for someone money-motivated who wants to grow with the business. High-volume cold calling or outbound lead generation experience is required; real estate or land investing background is highly favorable.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Make 150+ outbound dials per day minimum — fresh leads, follow-ups, and re-engagement

• Double dial and triple dial to maximize connect rates

• Take intake calls and gather qualifying information from sellers

• Convert conversations into booked appointments and push qualified leads to the closer

• Manage the inbound phone number and respond fast — speed of follow-up wins deals

• Follow up relentlessly on leads who missed proposal calls or intake meetings

• Fill downtime with outbound activity — there is always someone to call

• Disposition every lead accurately in the CRM

• Work a script while actively listening — hit the key points without sounding robotic



Success in this role is driven by daily activity volume, consistency, and speed of follow-up. You'll be measured on dials, connects, intakes completed, and appointments booked — clear KPIs, reviewed weekly.



THIS ROLE IS A STRONG FIT IF YOU



• Like repetitive outbound activity and get energy from volume

• Want performance metrics and clear KPIs — you always know where you stand

• Want commission upside tied directly to your activity and results

• Are aggressive, hungry, and self-motivated



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF YOU



• Come from a pure closing background and are used to only taking warm, pre-booked calls

• Prefer a handful of long conversations over high daily call volume



REQUIREMENTS



• Cold calling or high-volume outbound lead generation experience required — appointment setting, ISA, or BDR background

• Comfortable with 150+ dials per day, including double and triple dialing

• Very strong English fluency — clear, professional phone presence

• Available during US business hours

• Highly organized, accurate CRM work, strong follow-through

• Coachable and willing to learn our scripts and qualification criteria



BONUS EXPERIENCE (HIGHLY FAVORABLE)



• Real estate industry experience — land investing or land-specific experience even better

• Experience with GoHighLevel or GHL-based CRMs (we use Stride, built on GHL)

• AI-forward — comfortable using AI tools day-to-day



COMPENSATION



• $4–$7 per hour, based on experience

• Commission / performance incentives tied to activity and results after the evaluation period

• 60-day evaluation period. After 60 days, everything gets reevaluated

• Starting at 30 hrs/week with the opportunity to move to 40 hrs (full-time) based on performance

• Long-term position with growth opportunities



TO APPLY, PLEASE SUBMIT



• A recording of yourself — a real cold call or sales call recording is preferred, or a 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and your experience

• An internet speed test screenshot

• Your favorite food as the first line of your response



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who wants to grow with our company and play a key role in our acquisitions pipeline.

description:

I’m looking for a thoughtful, fashion-minded virtual stylist to help me bring order, creativity, and fresh vision to my existing wardrobe. I’ve already photographed my clothes, shoes, bags, and jewelry. Now, I need your eye to help me put it all together.



This is a remote position where you’ll help me create styled looks for different parts of my life: speaking engagements, church services, real estate client meetings, casual outings, travel days, and formal events. We’ll use the Indyx iOS app to build and organize my wardrobe, and I’ll cover the premium subscription if needed.



You won’t need to shop for me or build a wardrobe from scratch. I simply need help refining and coordinating what I already own into outfits that are appropriate, elegant, and true to who I am.



A Little About Me



I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Access my wardrobe photos inside the Indyx app and help me organize them by category, color, and occasion

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Use the app’s built-in photo editor to clean up background images and help the catalog look its best

Provide brief notes or explanations for each outfit so I understand how to pull it together myself



What I’m Looking For:



Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

Bonus if you have experience building digital lookbooks or working with speakers or professionals

Details:



This is a short-term project paid by the hour

Please include your hourly rate when you apply



We’ll begin with a paid trial task (such as styling 3 to 5 looks) and move from there



I’d love to get started right away, with the project expected to last around 3 to 4 weeks, depending on how we pace it



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your styling background

Your hourly rate

Any examples of work you’ve done; especially for clients who speak, teach, or lead professionally

Confirmation that you use an iOS device and are open to working inside the Indyx app

About Us



Banner Mountain Media is a U.S.-based video production and marketing agency serving home-service businesses, real estate firms, and architecture studios. We run paid advertising that drives real leads (phone calls and form fills) for local businesses, paired with high-quality creative produced in-house.



Role Overview



This is one role for one person who can do both halves: own the ad accounts AND make the creative that feeds them. You plan, launch, and optimize Meta 
/Instagram) and Google campaigns to hit a cost-per-lead and return-on-ad-spend target across several local-business accounts, and you concept and produce the ads that win: hooks, angles, static ads, and briefs for our video team. You d
 what to test next, make or brief it, launch it, and prove what worked. Real budget, real creative ownership, results-first.



This role requires consistent availability, reliable performance, and a long-term commitment.



Responsibilities



Own day-to-day buying across Meta and Google Ads for multiple clients at once: account structure, audiences, budgets, bid strategy, and conversion tracking.



Watch performance daily. Kill underperformers, scale winners, and keep spend pacing to budget against CPL and ROAS targets.



Own the creative test loop: research winning angles, write hooks, design static ads, and brief our video editors on what to produce next based on what is winning.



Build the full funnel (top, middle, bottom): each new creative tests a clear angle, and winners graduate into more variations.



Set up and verify tracking end-to-end: pixels, conversion events, GA4, UTMs, and CRM/offline conversions.



Report results on a clear schedule in plain numbers and plain language.



Flag policy and compliance risk before launch (Special Ad Categories, financing claims, and similar).



Required Skills & Experience



3+ years hands-on buying on both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (not boosting posts, not a single platform).



Proven lead-generation experience for local or service businesses (driving calls and form leads, not only e-commerce ROAS).



Hands-on creative production: you can write a scroll-stopping hook and design a clean static ad yourself (Canva, Photoshop, or similar), not just hand it off.



A track record you can show with real numbers: an account you took from one cost-per-lead to a lower one, or scaled spend while holding CPL/ROAS, plus examples of ads you made.



Strong conversion-tracking skills: pixels, GA4, conversion events, and UTM discipline.



Comfortable managing multiple accounts at once without dropping the ball.



Clear written English and a consistent daily reporting habit.



Stable high-speed internet and full-time availability with US business-hours overlap. Shift: 11:00 PM - 7:00 AM PH time.



Preferred (but not required)



Short-form video sense (you can cut or storyboard a Reel/TikTok, or brief an editor precisely).



GoHighLevel (GHL) or similar CRM experience.



TikTok and YouTube ads.



Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for home-service clients.



Landing page / CRO instinct (knowing when the problem is the page, not the ad).



What We Provide



Real budgets and real ownership of client ad accounts and their creative.



Consistent monthly workload and stable long-term projects.



Clear targets, SOPs, and an in-house video team that turns your briefs into finished assets.



Direct communication with the founder and the rest of the team.



Competitive monthly compensation based on experience and performance.



How to Apply



Submit the following:



The platforms you have run and roughly how much total ad spend you have managed.



One specific result with numbers (cost-per-lead before and after, or a scale while holding CPL/ROAS).



Two or three ad creatives you personally made (image or video), with one line on the angle each one tested.



The tools you use (confir
ta Ads Manager and Google Ads; list GA4, GHL, Canva, Photoshop, TikTok, LSA, GTM if you have them).



Your expected monthly full-time rate.



Your normal working hours and timezone, and confirmation you can commit full-time and long-term.

ntum

title: Leisure Travel Consultant w/ solid Amadeus exp + Morning Shift
description:
